tei:div.tei:p: mo

yan lag brgyad la gsum 'di na yod/ dang*/ lcai ro/ bdud dral yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dpal he ru ka 'di rtsa gsum por 'du/ ma'o/ nir tsaka gi brgyad/ bcom ldan 'das lam dus su| rtsa 'di dag ji spyi'i mtshan nyid/ lta bu lags/ lam du byas tsam na srid pa mthar thug tu sku gsum sbas par bsdus pa'i don zhu bde mi rtog pa gsum/ gsum rtsa byang sems gang ba/ yongs su gyur pa ste/ de ltar mngon du byas pa'i dus su gzung ba dang 'dzin pa dbu mar ma zad/ thams cad yongs su spangs pa'o/ / shes rab kyi ngo bo nyid du bzhag pa las/ thabs kyi ngo bor bzhag pa ma gsungs/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi dang*/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang*/ dbang po lnga dang*/ stobs lnga dang*/ rgya dpe la dran pa nyer bzhag sogs mi snang gsung byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang*/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dran pa nyer bzhag go/ pa'i mthar thug pa la sogs pa'i don 'di spyi don dang sbas don gnyis su/ rnam par 'grel ba byang chub kyi sems la 'jug pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// // mnyam sbyor gyi rtog pa dang por 'bras bu'i rgyud zhu ba kha bskang bas bshad pa'i rgyud do lo de tshig gi de ma thag pa sems bskyed la 'jug pa bstan pa de nas/ don thabs nyams su blangs pa de nas/ nas bcom ldan 'das la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mchod pa byas nas phyag 'tshal te dri ba/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ / 1dga' ba bzhi la sbyar ba gnyis 2sngags kyi theg pas thob par bya ba 3gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa rnams kyis bsgrub pa ma yin pa'i 'bras bu sa bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes 4sa bcu gsum pa de 'dus pa la sogs pa la'ang*/ bzhi po 'di la tsa kra gsang ba'i ji lta ba bzhin gyi/ ye shes 'di'i gong na/ bla med pa/ / 1thams cad kyi bcud dam 2rang byung ngam lhan skyes 3sa bcu gsum pa/

snying po ye shes dam pa'i spyod yul yin pas/ bcom ldan 'das mngom sum du/ bshad du gsol/ / lan/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'bras bu'i rgyud zhu ba'i phyir/ gsol ba btab par mkhyen nas rgyu'i rgyud sogs gsum/ rgyud rgyu rgyud ji ltar gnas pa gnas gyur 'bras bu'i rgyud sa bcu gsum pa/ thams cad kyi snying po rang rig pa'i chos mi rtog pa de/ ye shes mar me mi phyed pas/ rdo rje zhes bya ba de mngon du mdzad pa/ 'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ 'dus pa la sogs pa/ rgyud gsum po/ thams cad kyi nang du 'bras bu'i rgyud sa bcu gsum pa/ gsang ba 'di bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin nyid de snod min la gsang bar 'byung bas| gsang ba khyad par du 'phags pa ste ye shes dam pa'i spyod yul yin pas/ mchog gi dges pa 'byung ba'i gzhi yin pas/ na/ / dpe med pa'i bde ba myong bas/ rnam snang la sogs pa'i lha thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gyur pas thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu gnas der btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du bzhugs/ / rigs lnga'am ye shes lnga sangs bzhugs pa po'i rgyas bshad/ rgyas de nyid longs sku ltar na mtshan dpe 'bar ba/ kun gyi/ dngos sems gzhir gyur pas sems can gyi don la zhum pa med| dpa' ni/ / 1yab/ 2ka pra mi phyed pas/ 3rigs drug pa mtshan dpe 'bar ba yab yum zhal sbyor| rdo rje sems mi mthun pa'i phyogs 'joms pa la dpa' yum/zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang bas| bde ba'i mchog / 1longs sku/ 2chos sku/ 3spang ba dang ye shes/ 'di ni che ba'i bdag nyid/ bcom ldan rgyud gsum dus gcig tu sangs rgyas/ thabs shes rab gnyis med rnal 'byor yab yum zhal sbyor te/ / 1gang la khyab na/ 2chos sku ltar na/ yang na brtan pa snod bcud de la khyab pa'i chos nyid mngon du gyur pa'o brtan pa gzhal yas khang*/ rtag pa mi 'pho ba/ mchog tu rang rig las mi 'gyur bas/

yang*// zag med bde ba'i ngo bo/ yid srub tshim pa ste zag med kyi bde ba la yid sbyor bas rgyud gang ba'o// so sor skyes rgyu dang 'bras bu'i gnas skabs gnyis kar 'dod yon bsten pa'o// pa ni/ /rtag tu rang bzhin de mi spong ba/ mnan 'dod yon lnga ye shes kyi snang ba yin pas mi spong*| dka' ba/ / ste rgyud phyi ma/ mdzad pa sna tshogs de'i mdzad pa sprul sku ste mnyam sbyor gyi rtog pa dang po/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa'i don mi gsal ba gsal bas bshad rgyud/ las gang la gang 'dul de la de ston| gdul bya sna tshogs pa/ 'dul byed sna tshogs/ thabs sna tshogs/ kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ / thabs gang gis she na sna tshogs cho ga mi bskyod pa sogs pa'i dngos grub/ 'dod pa yi/ / gang zag de'i 'dod pa grub par bya ba'i phyir sangs 'dul byed/ rgyas phyi ma la sems par yod/ rdo rje 'dzin dbugs dbyung gi dkyil 'khor drug sogs rnams/ / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bstan/ thabs de'i sgo nas phrin las sems can rnams ni mdzad pa ru ni zer/ 'dul ba'i chos kyi don/ bar brjod | | par mdzad/ rigs brgya sangs rgyas kun rigs lnga sogs drug pa/ brtan de bai ro tsa na la sogs pa'i rang bzhin yin par ma zad/ dang g.yo/ / chos sku de thams cad la snang zhing khyab pas thams cad dngos po snod kyi 'jig rten ma lus pa la khyab/ srid pa nyid snang*/ 'di/ / sangs rgyas 1ye shes/ 2rnal 'byor te rgyas/ bai ro tsa na sogs kun dang mnyam dbyings/ sbyor ba | | de las byung ba dang bdag gcig pu/ 1chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar cir yang mi dmigs shing 2 de gang zhe na/ 3gang dang sbyar na mkha' 'gro ma yi chos sku gzugs sku gnyis/ dra ba ste sgyu ma la khyab par 'gro gzugs sku dpag med dang gnyis med du 'gro 'i sdom/ / 1de la brten nas rtogs pa/ 2ste spyan la sogs pa'i tshogs/ 3saṃ bha ra/ 'dis ni rdo rje 'dzin/ sgyu ma thams cad nyid bud med du snang*|

'i mdzad pa rgyas pa/ rnal 'byor bai ro tsa na la sogs pa'i yo gis mu dra spyan la sogs par bskyed nas sbyor bas/ gyis/ / spyan la sogs pa thams cad las ni gang la ci 'dul de la de ston/ sna tshogs mchog / 1phrin las rgyas par bzhag 2bai ro tsa sogs 3bud med kyis 'dul ba la dkar mo la sogs par sprul par phyi ma las 'byung sangs rgyas sogs de'i mdzad pa sprul sku ste mnyam sbyor gyi rtog pa dang po/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa'i don mi gsal ba gsal bar bshad/ pas 'dul ba'i phyir/ / bzhugs pa po'i rgyas bshad dngos grub 'dod pa'i/ sems can kun tu gyur pa'i mahā mu dra'i/ don mchog / tshul ji ltar bsten na rang gi ngo bos yongs bsgyur bas/ / rnam shes brgyad/ ye shes lnga gang la brten pa zhe na bud med kun spyan la sogs par bskyed/ gyi sgyu ma grub/ / pa la brten nas si ti/ sna tshogs spyan la sogs pa du ma/ sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di/ / rtogs dka' bas 'od zer can gyi sgra rang la bya mkha' 'gro ma zhes byings che go dka' bas/ kla klo'i skad/ /ḍai bai hā ya sa ga ma ne/ 'gro bar/ / ḍā ki ni skad byings rtags byed pa'i tshig nye bar bsgyur ba'o/ /de bsdus pa'i don/ ḍai bai ha ya byings/ e war+ṇaX i rtags/ ḍa rkyang du bya/ gu gu ka dang na la byin pas ḍā ki nir 'gro byed pa'i tshig go /gzhan phyi ma nye bar bsgyur ba'o// dbyings 'di'i sgra las drangs na don rnyed/ 'dir ni rnam par ḍā ki nir/ brtag / rdzu 'phrul gyis nam don gyi dbang du byas na/ mkha' kun ḍai/ tu bai| spyod tā cha hā ja grub ya/ pa/ / chos sku gang ltar yang mi rtog pa'i tshul gyis/ mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags / / phyogs kun phrin las rgyas/ hūm̐ las kha dog gi phrin las/ sna tshogs de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa'i/ phyag rgya ste/ / spyan la sogs pa la brten nas/ kun gang la bya| las sna tshogs 'dod chags sogs kyi rtog pa sdom/ sdom pa

saṃ bha ra/ yis/ / de ltar byas pas dngos grub gang thob ce na rdo a k+ṣo bh+ya'i rnal 'byor pas de'i dngos grub thob par byed/ rje rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /pad+ma 'i yo gis bsgom pas/ de bzhin pad+ma 'dzin pa thob par byed / /nor bu la bkod pas/ nor bu 'dzin pa nyid/ / de ltar thob par byed pa de yang 'di rnams kyi ni bai ro sogs| rigs rnams spyan la sogs pa/ yin/ / de ltar spyan la sogs pa dang snyoms par zhugs pa la brten nas ster ba'o/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don te thun mong ma yin pa'i 'bras bu chos sku ste/ stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sam/chos kyi sku zag pa med pa'i ye shes ro gcig pa la bzhed do| |de'ang*/dmigs med gnas kyi snying rje dang*/ /dmigs med gnas kyi shes rab nyid/ /blo dang lhan cig gcig gyur pas/ /nam mkhar nam mkha' ji lta ba'o/ /de'ang*/ 'di nyid las chu dang 'o ma bzhin du tha dad med par 'dzin to zhes pas kyang shes so/ /gzhan don gtso bo'i dbang du byas nas gzugs sku gnyis la sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nyid gtso bor bshad do/ /'chad lugs ni yan lag gi don gyis 'chad do zer ro de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'dus pa la sogs pas thob par bya ba/ thams cad sa bcu gnyis pa/ zil gyis gnon pa sa bcu gsum pa/rtog pa'i rdul dang bral ba'i snying rje dang shes rab/go 'phang*/ gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 'bras bu'i rgyud kyi don dam pa'i/ byang chub kyi sems sa bcu gsum pa/ 'di bka' stsal pa/ rtog mkhan gyi bsam pa dang sbyar na stong min dmigs med kyi snying rje dang ldan/ stong pa min 'di la rgyud phyi ma las gzhan du bshad/ pa'ang brtags na de ltar ma grub pas/ min/ /dbu mar dmigs par gnyis ka dang bral bar yang*/ mi 'gyur 'gyur ba bya ba phyi mar/ ro/ / mi dmigs pa'i shes rab pha hiṃ sa hi/ rol phyin pa ste/

sbyor ba/ / gang du sbyor zhe na thabs ni snying rje'i bdag nyid dang sbyor ba nyid/ de/ / de'i dbang gis des na mdzes pa'i hiṃ sa dang ldan pas/ snying yin hiṃ sa'i pradzñā rje des sems can gyi don byed pa'i dbang gis/shes rab la sogs pa'i yin dbang gis thabs | | shes rab pha rol phyin gsal ba/ / de rang bzhin med par rtogs/ rnam par/ rtog pa/ med pa'i chos kyi dbyings/ rnams la/ / dngos po dang dngos po med par yang rung dngos po dang dngos po med pa gang ltar yang ma yin pas gang ltar yang mi bsgom/ med cing 'bras bu de gnyis dang ldan pas/ bsgom pa'ang med/ /rnam rtog med par de lta bu de thob par byed pa'i thabs gang gis thob na/ lhag dang po slob pa'i gnas skabs su/ mos la'ang*/ / so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis brtag pa kun gyis ci yang ma yin par/ brtag par de ltar/ bya/ / de ltar brtags pas gang ltar yang ma grub par rtogs shing bsgoms pas/ 'bras bu grub pa chos sku rnam rtog med pa'i chos rnams la/ / mi rtog bzhin du snying rjes sems can don ni yongs su brtags/ / chos sku spros pa med pa nye bar zhi ba las skye med las skye ba'i cho 'phrul du de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi| bdag nyid kyi/ chos/ / kyi dbyings la/ don dam par chos can thams cad/ med cing chos nyid med/ /sgra brnyan lta bur mnyam pa nyid/ / rang bzhin med par ston pa'i ngag gi chos 'byung de de'i dbang gis/ nas 'di ni chos ngag byung*/ / de lta bu'i 'bras bu de thob pa'i nye ba'i rgyu lam bstan pa ni de byang sems kyi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ nas dmigs pa chen po ste lam rgya chen po| bsgrub rang gzhan gyi don/ pa la dmigs pa bsgrub pa chen po/ ye shes bdag med gnyis/ chen po/ brtson 'grus chen grangs med gsum/ po/ thabs mkhas snying rje shes rab kyis mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ngo*/ chen po thob pa chen sangs rgyas/

po/ las chen don byed/ po'o/ theg pa chen rnam pa gcig tu sbyor/ po lam gyi/ las de rjod byed las| byung ba'i don/ bsgom pas yon tan che ba'i 'bras bu/ rgyas pa tshogs su rgyud phyi ma las yod| rnams kyi 'das da lta ma 'ongs pa/ dus sku gsung thugs gsum rgyud phyi ma las sa mā ya gsum du| gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnam snang dbugs dbyung bar bstod pa'i tshul mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas mi gsal ba gsal/ bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis yang dag par bstod pa/ chos sku spros pa med par nye bar zhi ba las skye med las skye ba'i cho 'phrul du/ de nas gzhan don rgyas pa'i sgo nas bstod pa las/ dang po thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi bdag po sems can grol bar mdzad pa la bstod cing thabs/ phyag shes rab/ 'tshal lo | | sems can thams cad/ bdag nyid du/ skyes pa 'gro ba thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bor| gcig pa'i dngos po la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ / kun 'gro'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa'i sgo nas bstod/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i rgyu/ gti mug rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po/ gcod par mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ / gzhan gyi rgyud la spang pa bskyed pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i de gzhan gyi rgyud la ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas bstod pa kho na nyid thams cad la yod pa/ kyi ye shes skye ba'i dhū tī/ gcig tu gdul bya la/ ston par mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal te bdag rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ / dris yang ma tshang ba kha bskong*/ mchod pa byas nas phyag 'tshal te/ 'di skad ces gsol to// chos rnams thams cad mahā mu drar/ gcig pa'i sku/ / bcu gsum pa 'bras bu de mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ snying po bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ / zhu ba/lan bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dbang po 'i yul du gyur pa'i gzugasasogs/ gang dang gang lam nyid/

/ dbang po dang yul de dang lhan cig skyes/ de yi gzugs sogs/ rang bzhin las/ / de thams cad lhan skyes pa'i ngo bor mnyam par yul drug ma bzhag pa'i shes pa'i rgyu ba ma bkag kyang lhan cig skyes par shes pa'i/ rnal 'byor gyis/ / dus rtag par shin tu spyod lam thams cad du goms pa| mnyam gzhag rang bzhin lhan skyes/ nyid/ / de ltar rang bzhin lhan skyes de ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dbang po rnams lhug par bzhag pa'i sgo nas rnam par shes pa'i bsgom par bstan pa la/ 'o na rang bzhin lhan skyes de ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa de cis ma rtogs zhes rgol gang 1bstan/ 2 lan/ de'i phyir yang dri ba/ thams cad dbang po yul/ bdag nyid kyi/ / lhan cig skyes par bsgom pa de/ rnam par/ shes pa/ phung po sa ha dza/ ra gnas pa ni/ / sa ha dza de ci ste mi rtogs she na/ skyes pa cha bu ja

ma rtogs pa na/ tha ma sems rmaungs pa/ / 1ste gdams ngag dang ma phrad pa/2'i rigs pa can la sogs pa/ lhan skyes de la las so sor rtogs par/ mi nus/ / pa/ de kun gyis ji ltar rtogs she na sems shra bha ga dang rnam rtog med par lhag mos kyi don sems gzung pa dang 'dzin pa/ byung sems kyi rnam snang gi rigs tshul/ / lam ngo bo/ mu stegs pa rnams kyi rdzas ye shes tir ti nas phywa'am dbang phyug la sogs pa/ shes bya rang bzhin can/ / byed pa'i skyes bu bcu gnyis su/ 'bras bu thams cad kyi byed mkhan du rtog pa ste bdag gis byed zer/ rnams la byed pa nyid/ / de lta bu'i chos nyid/ rnams las su bya ba/ chos can kyi dngos por rtog pa/ dbang phyug chen po byed por sgom pa byed pa por rtog pa/ nyid/ / grub mtha' du ma yod pas dngos po du ma dang 'bras bu du ma yod dam zhe na gang de dag gis du mar btags kyang dngos po du ma min/ phyir chos ni du mas grub mtha' du ma/ ni/ / dpe chu bo'i rgyun du ma/ ni rgya mtsho 1 ra ro gcig pa/2chen por 'dres tsam na lan tshwar ro gcig pa bzhin dngos po gcig yin pas/ ltar/ / de rtogs pa'i 'bras bu thar pa nyid ni gcig pu nyid/ / de/ gnas lugs dang 'bras bu mang po dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ / dngos po'i gnas lugs gcig po de thabs gang gis rtogs she na/ rang gi sems nyid lhan skyes ji ltar nang du lhan skyes de rtsa dbu mar/ rnam gnas pa/ / sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag can las tshig gi man ngag rnyed pa'o zhes rgyud phyi ma las 'byung bla ma'i zhal las rnyed par 'gyur/ / thabs dang 'bras bu'i rgyud de kho na nyid mdor bstan pa ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// rten de spyir gzhung gi cha la du mar bshad du rung yang*/ bka' gdams kyi nye rgyu la 'chad do/ / de la don gnas gang du/ thabs gang gis/ dus nam gyi tshe/ 'bras bu gang zhig 'grub ces bya ba ston ste/

de ni tshig gang gis ston na/ e waṃ la sogs pas ston pa yin pas gzhung gi cha 'di rnam par 'grel ba yin| de la gnas la phyi'i gnas/ nang gi gnas/ mthar thug gi gnas du ma yod/ de bzhin du gzhan la'ang yod mod kyi 'dir gsang sngags thabs sngags lus la gnad du bsnun pas nang gi la sbyar nas snang ngo*| |e'i bshad pa ste e'i don rnam thar sgo gsum bstan/ de rtogs byed kyi nye rgyu'i rten gyi dbang du byas nas shes rab kyi chos 'byung bstan pa gnyis su go bar bya/ rnam par rtog pa la ni rgyu'i rgyud dngos po'i gnas lugs/ de las 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul yang shin tu rung sems te/ gsung ba ni thabs rgyud nye rgyu 'ba' zhig la sbyor/ nas 'dus pa la sogs pa bla na med pa'i/ rgyud rnams thams cad du/ / sbas pa'i yi ge sum cu rtsa bdun gyi brjod pa gtan la phab pa 1gleng gzhi 2 'dir 3brjod bya thabs dang 'bras bu'i rgyud 4mi gsal ba gsal ba'am ma tshang ba kha bskong ba'i tshul rab bshad bya/ / ka ma la sems can kun la de'ang bud med/ mnyam pa'i phyir/ / gnas 'di'i gleng gzhi bzhugs gnas gru spyir lta ba/rdzogs rim/nye rgyu gsum don 'dra la nyams myong gis dbye ba'i khyad par 'byed do// gsum thabs kyis zin na myang 'das/ ma zin na 'khor ba skyed pas/ rgya chen gzugs chos 'byung e bshad/ can nyid/ / de la ci skye zhe na/ tshangs sogs kyis bsdu ba dbang phyug chen po byang sems/ dang khyab 'jug dri chu/ sogs thabs kyis ma zin na/ lha dri chen dang gti mug dang lha thabs kyis zin na tshangs pa la sogs pa dang 'dra ba'i rigs lnga'i si ti/ min sha chen/ bcas/ / lnga po de rnams kyi ni kak+ko la ste/ gnas su 'gyur/ / 'bras bu de bzhugs pa'i gnas/ chos 'byung de nyid gnyis ma yin te/ shes rab pha rnam pa de'i mtshan nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i rten yin pas/ rol yang na rtags| phyin/ / pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas/

don de gang la brten nas rtogs na kun rdzob rnam pa'i gzugs can ma/ / la brten nas so/ sgra sogs kyis de de la brten pa'i gnas de'i mtshan nyid bstan| nyid yul rnam par mi rtog pa ste phar yang yul du mi byed tshur yang yul du bya ba ma yin pas| las rnam par 'das/ / mtshon byed/ 1 rtogs pa'i phan yon bstan 2de la brten pa'i lhan skyes kyi mtshan nyid bstan/ 3kun 'gro'i dbang phyug srog chags kun gyi snying la gnas/ / lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de phyir de rgyas par bstan pas/ ci zhig bya/ / don dam pa dang kun rdzob kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i ye shes/ thob bya thob pa'i phan yon mdor bsdus pas ni pa ra mi ta'i theg pas| sangs rgyas nyid/ / thob bo/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa nas kyang thob ste yun ring ste bskal pa bye ba grangs med pa gsum gyis/ sa/ /ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob pa/ / de/rnal 'byor pa gang gi dam pa'i rang byung ngam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi/ bde ba khyod/ / mtshon bya/ rnal 'byor pa skye ba 'dir ni rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ thob par 'gyur/ / mahā mu dra yang bla na med pas thob par bya ba/ na rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ / de ma thob kyi bar du yang yang na 'khor los sgyur ba rig pa 'dzin pa/ 'am/ / der ma zad/ 'dis ni dngos grub chen po brgyad/ / gzhan yang zhi rgyas dbang mngon spyod sogs/ yid la 'dod pa thob/ / der ma zad spang bya spangs pa'i phan yon/ gti mug chags sdang nga rgyal dang*/ /phrag don dang ni nyon mongs lngas || mtshon byed med pas sems can so sor bcing ba gang*// rang byung ngam lhan skyes rang gi lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa bskyed pa nyid kyis rang 'gag yan lag nyid kyis nyon mong / 'joms// phyag rgya'i ming 'byung*/ 1bskyed pa'i shu kra dang rdzogs pa'i shu kra gnyis kyi gzhan du snang ba/ 2ma bcos na skyon ci zhe na/3nyon mongs pa lnga po 'dis ni 'gro drug

rnam par snang mdzad sogs/ sems can bcings | | 'khor bar 'khor zhing skye ba nyid/ / rang byung gi ye shes mngon du byas pa/ ji ltar skye na nyon mongs pas ni rmongs gyur pas/ / der skye ba'i las sdig kun nas nyon mongs pa| pa du ma byed par 'gyur/ / lhan skyes rtogs pa na de nyon mongs pa las zlog pas skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa zlog pas/ phyir 'di spangs pa/ bcom cang ye shes/ mkhyen nyid/ / rang don grub pa'i phan yon/ gzhan don sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin/ kyis gnas de la brten nas thabs bstan nas thabs rtogs/ des 'bras bu thob pas sprul/ sprul rigs pas ni/ / 'og nas kyi thabs shes sprul gzhan don byed la/ des gang gi don byed na 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung ba yi/ / mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam sbyor ba dang*/ bral ba gzhan don byed pa'i gtso bo snying rje sdug bsngal ba/ mthong nas ni/ / 1gtum mo sbar ro 2rdo rje dang pad+ma sbyor ba de la brten nas rang byung lhan skyes 3rdzogs rim gyi thabs shes thabs yab/ dang shes yum/ rab sprul pa'i rgyus/ / spyan la sogs pa nyid bral ze la sogs pa dang sbyor bas lhan skyes de skye/ de las rigs lnga'i dngos grub 'byung bas/ sdug bsngal gyi nyon mongs pa'i sems can/ rnams ni nyon mongs spangs nas/ yid ches mahā mu dra| 'gyur/ / sems can phyag rgya chen por mtshon pa 'di ni 'bras bur 'gyur/ / de dag bshad pa khams gsum du ni mahā mu dra/ dri med snang*/ / sbyang gzhi ni nyon mongs/ gdul bya gang rā ga dang de ṣa sogs pa/ dang gang gi bskyed rim gyi dbang du byas nas thabs shes sprul/ gnas gyur pa/ / rdo rje 'dzin de ni gti mug sogs kyi gnyen po'am/ de spangs pa las byung ba/ zhe sdang shas che ba la mi bskyod pa bsgom pa la sogs pa de yi ngo bo can/ /bud shing bsregs pa'i mes bud shing bsregs pas me bud shing gi rigs yin/ rigs pas ni/

/ de gnyis ka'i sems can gyi don mdzad pa la/ dges nyon mongs bsregs pas de'i rigs shes bya'o/ / pa'i rgyal ba gang mkhan mchog | sbyang gzhi/ phung po don byas pas sbyang gzhi 'am/ spangs bya dag pa'i tshul bstan pa/ khams dang skye mched rnams/ / badz+ra dhar 'di sbyang gzhi/ nyid sa ha dza/ rnam dag mtshon pa 'di/ / gang la cis 'dul ba de la der ston pa/ ji ltar dgra bo'i nus pa dang ldan pa/ la/ /dgra bo'i nus pas kyang*/ de bsnun pa/ / ste che bar bstan pas 'dul/ gdul bya'i rgyud la yod pa'i gti mug dag pa ra bya ba'i phyir de bas kyang gti mug che ba/ rnam snang du bstan pa des de'i sgrub pa po byar rung la/ de nyid la med bzhin du snang ba spyan med bzhin du bram ze mor snang ba de dang sbyor bas rnam snang gi dngos grub 'byung ba gti mug dag ces bya'o/ /des 'gre/ sa gti mug ste/ / de bas che ba ltar snang*| zhe sdang dag pa ra bya ba'i phyir/ sa zhe sdang mi bskyod pa/ nyid/ /'dod chags dag pa ra bya ba'i phyir/ sa 'dod chags te/ / 'od dpag med du bstan/ nga rgyal rnam dag par bya ba'i phyir/ nga rgyal che/ / rin 'byung du bstan/ phrag dog dag pa ra bya ba'i phyir/ sa phrag dog nyid | | don grub tu bstan/ nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par/ dag par bya ba'i phyir/ rdor 'dzin mgon/ / du bstan pas don du ji ltar 'gyur snyam pa la lan rgyusaX kyi bar/ nyon mongs pa de yi ngo bo rnam dag pa/ rigs drug dang ye shes drug tu/ / nyon mongs lnga po thams cad dag par/ ni mnyam par 'gyur/ / 'dis ni tsaṇ+ḍā lī gsum pa zhar la bsten te lte ba'i 'dab ma la ā li bco lnga bsgom pa ste lnga gsum bco lnga'o/ / de rdo rje la sogs pa/ ltar rigs ni lnga rnams dang*/ /ye shes lnga dang sangs rgyas lnga/ / ste bco lnga mnyam par ster ro/ rim pa gnyis po rang bzhin lhan skyes 'di las rdo rje snying po dang*/ khro bo bcu dang*/ khams bskal ba'i ming*/

gsum gyi*/ sems can thams cad/ skye/ / rang byung ngam lhan skyes nang rang gi sems nyid lhan skyes/ gi dbye ba 'di nyid ni/ / gang las gang gi tshe grub pa bla ma'i zhal las rnyed par 'gyur/ / de las zlog bla ma med na/ dman pa'i gdams ngag mi ldan pa'i/ sems can gyis lhan skyes mi rtogs rnams | | mahā su kha de mi rnyed par ma zad/ sngags dang phyag rgya rnyed mi 'gyur/ / ā tsar+ya gang zhig gdams ngag shin tu tad to'i rtogs pa/ gsal bas ni/ /'dzam gling ār+ya'i de 'dir sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar/ bsngags/ / pa dang phrad na rtogs/ 'di na mar gleng gzhi'i e waṃ gyi bshad pa yi ge'i don gyi sbas pa'i don rang byin gyis rlabs pa'i rim pa/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems ltar bshad/ de las kyang dang po lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo yi ge ji ltar dgod pa dang bcas pa bshad do/ gru lte ba'i nam mkha' stong pa/ gsum dag pa ni rang byung ngo*/1'di dag gis ni gtso bo mchog gi dngos grub kyi rgyu byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgom nas de'ang spyod pa'i mtha'/ zhag bdun gyi mtha' la phyi'i skya rengs 'char kha nang gi byang sems brgyad drug gi bdag nyid dbu mar mngon du byas pa de'i tshe 'grub par bstan te/ de ma thob kyi bar du dman pa dang 'bring yang thob par bstan no/ e phyag rgya bstan pa'i dbang du byas te e'i bshad pa bstan/ yi dbyibs/ / rang byung ye shes kyi gnas yin pas/ nir tsaka gi dbus su dbus su dges pa'i e waṃ a shad lta bu/ yin/ / gzhi yin pas gru gsum| des ci byed na zer snyam gru gsum dkyil 'khor nyams dga' rang byung gi ye shes/ bar | | rnam par rtog pas cha gtum mo ཾ ye shes mi phyed/ rdo rje ra li'i rol ba'i ngo mtshar/ rnam par byung*/ / ye shes phab pa dang gzhir gnas pa 'dres/ nang ltar gyi btsun mo'i nir/ bha ga zhes kyang bya// thabs kyis zin pa dang ma zin pas chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes byar bshad//

nir ma tsaka ྄ de yi nang sngar gyi/ son pad+ma ni/ / lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad pa snying por bcas | | nir ma de la ā li kā li sa bskor ba la bya/ 'dres/ / tsaṇ+ḍā lī bzhi pa zhar la bstan/ nang skor na sde tshan brgyad ni rnam par gnas/ / de'i dbus su sngags lte ba aṃ/ kyi gzugs kyis lus can gyi/ / aṃ de las e waṃ byung e las ā li/ waṃ las kā li gnyis/ de las a ka tsa ṭa sogs pa/ de las zhi sogs las kyi tshogs ni de las me sbar te babs pas rtog pa zhi ba la sogs/ byed par 'gyur/ / rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs mi gcig pa dang*/ blo'i spyod yul mi gcig pa la dgongs nas gsungs yi ge rnams ni ā li bcu drug kā li sum cu bzhi/ lnga bcu nyid/ /rig byed ni bzhi ste 'khor lo bzhi'i nir tsaka gi dkyil la 'dab ma la ste brgyad char la ak+ṣa ra lnga bcu lnga bcu dgod/ rnams la nges par rdo rje lus kyi bye brag dang gang zag gi bye brag gnas/ / sngags de ltar bsgom na/ rnams nyid dang rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rgyud dam gzugs bsgyur ba/ sa dang*/ / phyi rol du bsten pa yang e waṃ las byung zhes kyang sbyar shes nas bsgom pas kyang 'byung*/ tshul gyi bstan bcos pa ra mi ta ya na/ kyi/ /rdo rje snying po zhes bos nas/ rang bzhin aṃ/ las byung ba 'di | | aṃ gzhan du 'di las gzhan 'byung ba'i rgyu/ cung zad med/ / rgyas a de dag gi rgyu/ ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha / de las byung ba'i sde tshan dga' ba lnga bcu yang*/ / 'khor lo bzhi char la mnyam 'dab brgyad yin la de re re la sde tshan brgyad/ pa dag tu sprul pa rnams/ / bkod|thabs sgrub pa po rdo rje ra li'i shes rab phyag rgya 'khor lo bzhi ka la gsung*/ pad+mor son/ / gnyis ka'i nir pad la yod/ 'dab brgyad so sor phyogs dang ni/ / sde tshan brgyad/ mtshams rnams su ni sde tshan brgyad po/ 'di rnams dgod par/ rigs/ / nir te'i sde brgyad/ de rnams las khyad par du/

dbus kyi/ su ze 'bru la/ / sde tshan brgyad kyi dam pa'i dbang phyug ma aṃ/ yod de/ /sde tshan brgyad po rnams kyi ni/ /yi ge dam pa aṃ/ yongs su bskor/ / don skye med yin pas a ni yig 'bru kun phyi nang gi brjod pa'i don gyi'o/ / gyi mchog / sde tshan thams cad bskyed pas don chen sde tshan gtso bo ni/ / de'i byed pa lus can kun gyi sngags kun ni/ /de nyid las ni yang dag byung*/ / der ma zad aṃ de las me sbar te yas phab nas de'i dmigs pa dang ma bral bar bsgrub na/ gang ral gri'i nam mkha'/ zhig ral gri dang*/ mig mig sman gyis 'jig rten gsum mthong ba/ sman sa 'og 'gro 'am ral gri'am/ /tshar gcod phan 'dogs nyid dang ni/ /ril bu mig sman gter rnams so/ /rkang mgyogs dag gam bcud kyis len/ /a bhi dha na le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa las so/ /ril bu dang ni mig sman dang*/ /gter dang dgra rnams brlags pa dang*// rkang pa byug dang ral gri dang*/ /gnod sbyin mo dang bcud kyis len/ /ḍā ka las so//

dang*/ rkang mgyogs rkang byug dang*/ ril bu mi snang ba dang mkha' spyod/ dang*/rkang sa 'og 'gro zer/ sa 'og gi sid+dhi 'og gter zer/ dang*/ gnod sbyin ma'i dbang du byas te mngag gzhug yan lag ma dang*/ bcud len 'jig rten gsum tshe dang*/ longs spyod/ lus/ gyi khongs su rgyu de la brten nas dngos grub bsgrub/ ba dngul chu'i 'gro ba rjes su 'brang ba/ gang zhig dgra brlag pa'am tshar gcodaphan 'dogs/ thams cad du mthu 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'am skad cig 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub che ba/ de dag gi rgyu rang gi khyim du ā li kā li/ lnga bcu 'dod pa dang ldan pas 1rang gyi khyim du bya/ 2mngon du bya bas bsgrubs na/ 'grub po/ / tsaṇ+ḍā lī lnga pa shugs bstan de 'di'i bsgom pa 'khor lo gcig la brten pa'i tsaṇ+ḍā lī te/ ni sde aṃ tshan brgyad nang son/ / aṃ de dbyangs mchog sdai tshan bdag nyid 'byin/ / de las skye bo rnams kyi tshig rgyas pa/ / ci dang ci smra ba/ gang zhig cung zad rtogs bya ba/ / sa mnyan pa'i tshul gyi/ ā li kā li smra ba de kun sngags kyi yang na btus pa smra pa/ gzugs kyis ni/ /de phyir aṃ las/ rab tu thams cad rten 'brel gyis smra ba thams cad/ skye bar 'gyur/ /lus can sgrub pa po/ rnams ni thams cad kyi/ / brjod pa'i sgra aṃ shad lta bu la sbar te yas mar phab pas yid skyobs/ ni sngags zhes aṃ las byung*/ brjod par bya/ / phyis brdar/ de'i gnas gang na sna tshogs mdud pa'i rtsa gnyis kyi mdud pa klu dbang gyi dbyibs/ gnas chen las/ /chos kyi ra li ni dharma ste dha dharma ste 'dul ba/ma ma na yid te rtogs bcas kyi yid 'dul ba ni bde ba'o/ / rnam par 'byung*/ / sngags 'di la dngos grub 'di 'grub ces pa'i nges pa med kyang aṃ bskul na sngags thams cad las sid+dhi 'grub dngos grub rdzu 'phrul rnam gnas pa'i/ / gang la 'grub sngag sa kyi nges pa gang yang med/

/ pa thams cad 'grub pa ci ste zhe na/ de ci'i phyir zhe na rang aṃ de ā d+ya nud pan+na tād/ bzhin gyis ni ma skyes phyir/ / de la skye ba'i chos 'byung ba'o/ sngags ni yig 'bru'i dbang phyug mchog / de yan chad skye gnas gtso ba'i dbang du byas nas lte ba sprul/ nir tsaka dang su tsaka gnyis sam su dang dhar gnyis yang e waṃ ma ya brtags nas skye ba'i gnas mtha' dag gi dbang du byas pa 'khor lo bzhi la sbyar ba/ dag thabs shes/ sbyor byung rgyu'i/ mtshan nyid me sbar ro| ni/ / thabs kyi rgyu gnyis med mtshon/ de nas mchog tu rab bshad bya/ / dbyibs kyi sgo nas e sa ni 'byung ba bzhi las/ sa ru shes par bya/ / mu dra bzhi las las kyi phyag rgya lha mo bzhi las/ spyan ma nyid/ / tshad med bzhi las snying rje chen mo pa ra mi ta bzhi las/ thabs chen mo | | kha dog rang bzhin sna tshogs spyod yul ma/ / gnas lte bar sna tshogs 'dam skyes la/ / rigs de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su yong ngam snyam/ dris pas rat+na'i rigs yin gsung ngo sprul pa'i 'khor lor rnam par gnas/ /waṃ dbyibs kyis bstan/ ni chu ru shes par bya/ / chos kyi phyag rgya mā ma kī/ /byams pa dang ni smon lam tshul/ /lha mo rdo rje'i rigs gtso ma/ /snying kha chu skyes 'dab brgyad la/ /chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas | | dbyibs ma ni me ru brjod pa ste/ /phyag rgya chen mo gos dkar mo/ dga' dang stobs kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /lha mo pad+ma'i rigs byung ma/ /lkog mar chu skyes 'dab brgyad gnyis/ /longs spyod 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ / dbyibs ya ni rlung gi rang bzhin te/ / rtogs pa'i rta rlung 'gags pas rtog pa spong nyon mongs thams cad rab 'joms byed/ /dam tshig phyag rgya chen mor nges/ /lha mo las kyi rigs gtso ma/ /btang snyoms ye shes rnal 'byor gyi/ /sgrol ma 'khor ba sgrol ba mo/ /'dam skyes 'dab ma sum cu gnyis/ /bde chen 'khor lo chen por gnas

| | pad+ma e shes rab ye shes thob pa las kā le'i bdag nyid kun rdzob/ ni shes phyag rgya| rab brjod par bya/ / sgrub pa po waṃ ni thabs rdo rje dang ldan pa nyid/ / bā+o la waṃ gis rnam par brgyan pa nyid/ / kak+ko la e ni nges par de gnyis sbyor ba las/ mdzes par mahā su kha/ 'gyur/ / gnyis ka la'ang e waṃ bstan thabs mdzes spyi/ dang shes rab kak+ko la/ rang bzhin mdom gru gsum/ gyis/ / rdo rje steng dang kak+ko la/ mdzes spyi dang 'og tu snyoms par mdom| 'jug / thabs la yang mdom gru gsum e rdo rje waṃ e nyid dang ni waṃ nyid ni/ / gnyis gnyis su ni brjod pa nyid/ / 1spyi don 2 de ltar nye rgyu des sgrub pa po'i 'bras bu gang zhig 'grub na spyi don gyi dbang du byas na 'khor dang ston pa tha dad ky-i snang ba 'byung la/ sbas don gyi 'di dbang ltar gyi mthar thug gi dbang du byas na tha mi dad kyi snang ba 'byung bar ston 3'di 'bras bu gang zhig 'grub pa brjod bya'i don spyi/ rjod byed yan lag gi don gyis bshad 'di skad gang thos/ ces bya ba'i tshig gi phrad ni/ / sdud pa po'am/ 'di skad nas de skad ces gsungs bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la dga' bzhi'i bar/ nas zhes bya ba'i chos kyi snang ba/ mthar thug pa'i bar gyi/ rgyud kyi tshogs la rjes su yi rang ba/ snyegs so zhes brjod do/ / 'di dbang sngar gyi bdag sbas pa/ gis thos pa zhes bya ba ni mahā rā ga'i sgra las/ de skad du thabs dang shes rab snyoms par bzhugs pa las/ 'dod chags zag med gyi bde ba/ chen po 'di la rtag tu gnas pa'o// rdor pad thos zhes sru ta/ bya ba ni sru pra ba dha du na/ 'dzag gtum mo sbar bas sam thabs shes snyoms 'jug byas pas byang sems/ par rang byin rlabs dang dbang ltar gnyis ka'i/ gsungs so/ / pa ta pi ta ra ste/ zhes bya ba ni gang yang bde ba chen po rgyas pa/ 'i mgon po'o/ / spyi bdag 'khor gyi snang ba/

gis pha rol tu phyin pa/ thos pa zhes bya ba ni badz+ra gar+bha/ bdag nyid kyis gang gi thos pa'i phyir nye ba'i tshig gis thos pas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa bkag pa ston| rna ba'i ye shes kyis thos pa yin thos pa'i shes rab kyis yin no/ gyi bslab pa bsgoms byung gi shes rab kyi don mngon du gyur pa ni/ ni ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das bslab pa'i mngon du'i/ skyon gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sdud par de'i phyir ston pa dang 'khor tha dad par ston/ byed pa dang 'chad pa po dag dbyer med par 'gyur ro/ /yang de ltar byas pas sdud pa po dang rgyud kyi don rtogs pa la 'gal ba med do/ /don dam pa mthar thug tu ston pa dang 'khor tha dad med pas so/ /'o na tha dad par snang ba ni/ na mthar thug tu/ bslab bcom ldan 'das la sogs pa'i bshad pa shes par bya/ pa tha dad med/ nyid ste mngon du gyur pa la yang 'gal ba med do/ / ni gdul 'di skad bdag gis thos pa/ bya'i skye bo'i dbang du byas nas chos bshad pa'i snang ba bstan pa'i phyir/ 'chad pa po nyid sdud par byed pa ra bstan pa/ tha dad du snang ba yin te/ dngos po la tha dad med de 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*/ /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga*/ / 'o na tha dad du bstan pa de dag tha dad du snang ba'i rgyu/ ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ / phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i dus gang du bde ba chen po'i mgon po nyid du mar/ gar gyi rol pa/ mdzad pa ston pa lta bu/ gcig dang*/ ngo bo rang la gdul bya'i ngor/ du ma'i ro zhes bya ba'i tshig gi rol par mdzad pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das kyis gang cung zad gsungs pa de bdag gis gcig na zhes bya ba ni dus gcig thos pa shes rab che ba dang*/ gzhan du gzhan yang thos pas thos pa mang ba dang*/ nyid la'o/ / mthar thug pa gcig yang na spyi don du gsungs/ na zhes bya ba ni gzhan du ma thos pas rnyed par dka' ba/ ska da cig la'o/

/ mngon du gyur pa/ thos pa zhes bya ba ni lhag par son pa mngon du gyur pa/ ste rnam par thar pa'i sgo/ 'dis bsam gyis mi khyab pa la lhag par mos pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnyed do zhes bya bar snyegs so// 'di la tsakra dang gsum dus gang gi tshe/ zhes bya ba ni dus tshad gang yin zhe na/ dus tshod spyod lam bzhi las chod 'chad cing bzhugs pa'i spyod lam gyi dus so/ / ces bya bar gsungs so/ /sa ma ye ni dus gsungs te/ / de yang dus ni rnam sbas pa/ pa gsum du brjod/ /bde ba'i dus dang sdug bsngal dus/ / bsam gyis mi khyab dus nyid do/ / mdor bstan no//rgyas 'o lam du byed tsam na/ ma'i rgyun ltar byang chub kyi sems/ sna dbang ltar na thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pa'i dus kyi rlung 'byung 'jug rang la sbyar/ bug tu/ / g.yon nas nang du rngub pa'i dus su 'ong brkyang ma nas byang sems/ ba bde ba'i skye ba/ dus su 'tsho bar byed pas/ gsungs/ / ro ma nas me yi u pra'i byang sems gnyis 'dres pa'i dus su sa ha dza mi rtog pa mngon du byas pas de'i tshe bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dus yin par bstan/ gzugs kyis rlung phyir/ 'gro ba nyid/ / 'chi bar byed pas/ sdug bsngal dus dang 'khor lo gong ma rnams bsregs pas/ de gcig grags/ / kun 'dar du mngon du bya ba'i dus su gcig ni lhan cig rtog pa/ med pa yin/ / 'gro 'ongs spangs pas dus mtshan ma dang rtog pa'i bsam pa dang bral bas/ ni bsam gyis mi khyab de yan gtso bor rang byin rlabs 'gyur/ / ba la bcom ldan 'das kyi bshad pa med/ 'di man gtsor bor dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i 'dod chags dag pa/ med cing chags bral dga' ba/ med/ / pa ra ma dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ / de rgyas par de la 'dod chags dga' ba/ nus mtshan nyid/ / rtog pa bskyed| 'dod chags bral ba phyi rol gyi rtog pa/ 'gog par gsungs/ / gnyis po 'di dang*| bral dbu mchog dga'/

ma sa ha dza/ mi rtog pas/ /'di gsum dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ / thabs kyi byang sems 'dod chags nyid dang shes rab kyi byang sems/ chags bral nyid/ / kha snar 'dres par gyur pa rtog pa'i/ rnyog pa med/ / de ltar de mjug sdu ba'i tshul| bzhin 'dod chags u tsi/ chags bral bas/ / kha snar 'dres pa ro mnyam rtog pa dang ma 'grogs pa/ gcig pu'i skad cig ma/ / rnam par mi rtog pa dngos po kun gyi ro mnyam pa/ / rtog pa dang ma 'grogs/ bsgom pa'i dus ni gcig tu de mngon du byed pa'i bsam pa dang bral ba/ gsungs/ / de'i dus su mngon du byed pa'i lhan skyes kyi mtshan nyid/ bcom ldan 'das la sogs pa'i bshad pa shes par bya/ de lta bu'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa la rten bskyed pa'i rim pa dgos pas bskyed rim shugs kyis shes par bya'o/ /spyi 'di gang las/ lta ste/ dbang shes rab phar phyin/ phyug dang | bzod pa'i phar phyin/ gzugs bzang ba/ dang*/ tshul khrims/ grags pa che ba/ dang*/ sbyin pa dpal bsod nams/ dang*/ ye shes bsam gtan/ dang*/ brtson 'grus kyi mtshon pa'i snying rje/ phun sum tshonas pa ste bha ga drug ces gsungs so/ / bha ga aṃ sa de 'di la mnga' ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das so/ / bha ga bhadzña na yang na gang zhig la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi chos bdud bzhi/ de rnams bcom pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das so/ / mahā mu dra de nyid/ badz+ra dha ra de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa pa ra spy-i/ thams cad bskyed spy-i/ kyi gnyis pa sku mtshan dpe/ dang bzhi pa gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu/dang drug pa thugs me long lta bu sogs/ rnams dang*/ bcu drug pa de rnams nyid kyi snying po dang*/ gang du/ gnas/ de shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de bzhin nyid/ nyid kyi rtog pas mi phyed pas/ rdo rje dang*/ de nyid kyi longs spyad par bya bas/ btsun mo dang*/ de'i de nyid rtogs pa dang mtshan ma 'joms pas/ bha ga de la thams cad kyi snang ba/

bzhugs so/ /kyai mthar thug gi dbang du byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das bzhugs zhes bya bas 'dis/ ci gsungs pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ mtha' thug la sprul sku'i bzhugs pa yi ge'i don gyis bshad na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ro gcig pa gang la ci 'dul gyi/ thabs bi dza ha ra las bi bi tsi tra las/ sna tshogs kyis 'dul ba'i dza dzan ma/ skye bo'i yid khams dwangs ma/ bzhugs nas ci byed na ha ra ste 'phrog pa dang ldan pa ste de'i don byed pa/ zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de ltar zhes mjug bsdu ba'i tshul du bstan gsung de bzhin gshegs pa btsun mo dang bha ga'i bshad pa gsal bar ston nam brtag go/ thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po de/ rdo rje'i gnas| rang bzhin yang na/ gang gi 'di nyid/ chos kyi 'byung shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de bzhin nyid la/ dbyings la gnas la de lta bus gang du/ gang gi tshe ye shes/ bcom ldan 'das dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis/ bzhugs pa de'i tshe de la kā ya'i/ bdag gis thos pa'o/ / don mngon du gyur pa/ 'di lta ste/ bha ga'i bshad pa/ shes rab kyi de bzhin nyid stong pa'i/ dbang gis nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa 'joms pa de'i phyir shes rab nyid la/ bha gar gsungs te/ de'i ngo bor/ bha ga der de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ spyan la sogs pa'i btsun mo lhan cig zhal sbyor/ tu bzhugs so/ / ngo mtshar e btsun mo de dang lhan cig tu bzhugs pa la/ dgos pa ci yod ce na/ ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /kun mkhyen pa'i/ ye shes chos sku'i bzhugs pa/ bla na med/ / pa dang ldan pa'i| de bzhin gshegs pa'i bde ba bskyed pa'i/ don gang*/ / rang sprul nas btsun mos nye bar mdzad pa de'i phyir de dang lhan cig bzhugs pa/ 'o/ / longs spyod kyi bzhugs pa dang chos sku'i bzhugs pa gnyis ka bstan to snyam/ de ltar bstan pa'i gzhung bsdu ba'i tshul gyis ston pa dang*/

gnas dang*/ ston pa'i mdzad pa ston rigs kyi bu zhes bos nas/ 'di skad mthar thug bdag ya tha| gis thos pa zhes pa'i ston pa badz+ra dha ra/ bya ba ni dharmā chos 'byung gi rnam grangs/ la ma tha| sogs ta ya/ par yig e waṃ sogs 'bru ste chos kyi dang por/ bzhis bstan pa'i de bzhin nyid de la rtag sbas par chos 'byung gru gsum tu yang dag par ston pa de/ gnas pa ste/ de'i phrin las dag thun mong ba rigs lnga/ pa dang yang sa bcu gcig pa bcu gnyis pa bcu gsum pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi dngos grub sangs rgyas kyi dngos grub gzhan don du/ gdul bya la skyed par byed pa'o/ / don spyi sbas mthar thug gsum du bshad rgyud gzhan du ma bshad lag na rdo rjes

gzhan la/ ma bshad pa de tan tra gzhan du mthar thug tu ma bshad pa de/ ngas khyod la tshig gi sgro btags nas/ bshad do/ / ud/ 1rjod byed/ 2gnas pūl+li ra ma la ya/ 3dar mo ta ya yig tshig zer/ 'bru 'di sbas pa ltar phyag rgya'i/ rnams bha ga'i che ba'i yon tan bshad pa la dris pa'o gsungs| kyis/ bstan pa'i don du sems can rnams chos 'byung der ā li dang kā li mngon tu byas pa las mahā mu dra thob ste/ 'khor ba las pha rol tu shin tu ring bar 'gro ba mngon du 'bras bu gnyis po/ mtshon par mdzad pa dang*/ lha'i 'du shes la sogs pa dang ldan pas byang sems chos drug gam brgyad kyi bdag nyid can gyis mngon du byas nas 'grub kyi tha mal pas phyag rgya bsten na mngon du ma mdzad pa bsam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pas phan yon 'byung na/ de rtog pa/ nub pa'i sems kyis mngon du ma byas pa de byas na/ dus nam gyi tshe skye 'bras bu sa bcu gsum pa 'grub dus| ba 'dir/ sangs rgyas nyid dam/ rigs lnga'am sa bcu pa/ 'bras bu dngos badz+ra dha ra bcu gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa' thob par 'gyur te/ 'o na sangs rgyas rang gang la bya zhe na 'bras bu'i rgyud kyi gang dag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ste rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang*/ ma thob pa de ni sa bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i/ bde bar gshegs pa ste bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa ste gsang ba'i rgyud rdo rje theg pa las/ sangs rgyas pa ni bla na med pa yin te/ de'ang yang dag pa'ang yin te theg pa chen po la gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /rnal 'byor dang*/ bya ba dang*/ mdo sde las sangs rgyas pa ni gong na yod pas bla dang bcas pa'ang yin la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'ang ma yin te/ theg pa gong na yod pa'i phyir ro/ /theg pa chung ngu las sangs rgyas pa dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas ni bla dang bcas pa'ang yin la/

yang dag par rdzogs pa'ang ma yin ste theg pa gong na yod pa dang*/ theg pa chung ngu las phyir bzlog dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na sangs rgyas gsum du shes par bya'o/ /zhes mkhas pa smṛ tis bshad do// sangs rgyas yin la/ mtshon bya mtshan gzhi/ badz+ra dha ra/ mtshon par byed pa ni thabs shes sbyor ba'i brgyad dam drug gi bdag nyid la brten nas thob pa'i rdo rje 'chang*/ sems dpa' yang dag par gsungs te/ tha mal pa'i nyes dmigs bsten thabs khyad par can gyis/ pa tsam gyis thabs kyi mi mthun pa'i spang bya/ mnar med par sogs su/ rab tu ltung bar 'gyur bas phan yon| kun tshul ji ltar bsten pas phan yon 'byung ba/ nas 'dod pa'i nyon mongs de bas na/ pa can gang zag gyi sems kyi tha mal pa'i bsten pas/ ro spong bar byed do/ / tha mal pa'i sbyor ba kun nas nyon mongs pa can gyi gang zag su na/ srid pa'i 'jigs pa las 'das pa'i sgrub pa po tshogs gnyis kyi/ dpal dang ldan dhar mor mngon du byas pa'i zhu ba pradzña pa de dzñā na'o| | pas sa ha dza dag thabs kyi ngo bo/ pa'i sems kyi/ skad cig la mngon par byang chub pas| bsgom par byed de thabs rang gi ngo bo/ mu tra thabs sgrub pa po/ dang shes rab kyi sbyor ba des ji ltar res 'di yang 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang rang du/ yang dag par thob pa dag yin te zer| pa'i yang dag par rig pa'i bdag nyid can gyi mtshan gzhi thabs dang mtshon bya'am thob bya/ mtshon byed shes rab kyi snyems pa'i/ brgyad dam drug nus pas mtshon byed de/ phan yon ji lta bu 'byung ba'i dpe nam spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bas/ mkha' dang mnyam zhing gnas gsum sa 'og sa bla sa steng*/ du snang ba ste/ de'i mtshan gzhi ni mtshon par rgyal bas kyang rtogs par dka' zhes bya ba 'byung*/ dka' rgya mtsho ltar/ ba dang*/ khyad par du chos sku'i mtshan nyid thams kun 'gro'i dbang phyug cad du son zhing sems can gyi rgyud dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes/

zag bcas kyi rgyu dang rkyen spangs pas mi rtog bzhin/ yid 'bras bu de/ bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur dpe'i sgo nas/ 'jig rten gyi rang dang gzhan gyi don byed de/ dngos grub thams cad kyi mchog go /rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi gsang ba dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i brtag pa'i rgyal po ste dang po rdzogs so || || ༈ 1'di nyams su blangs ba ni 'og bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ bdun pa'i gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ phyi ma dang*/ lnga sbyar te shes par bya'o/ 2'dir slob dpon gang las/ dbang gang*/ dri ma gang dag lam gang la/ dam tshig gang yin/ dpe ci dang 'dra zer te 'di gtsor mi gsung*/3brtag pa dang po'i le'u bcu pa dang cha mthun par bshad pa'am/ de'i don mi gsal ba gsal ba'am/ma tshang ba kha skong ba de nas yang dag rab bshad pa'i don dkyil 'khor bri ba'i rim pa/ bya/ / dgos pa lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag pa sgrub pa po la phan don du/ / slob dpon gang gis slob ma dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bskur ba'i/ / lus ngag yid gsum gyi las su bya ba cho ga yang ni bshad par bya/ / bsnyen pa sngon du song nas dang dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sngon du/ po lha yi phyag gnyis pa'i/ bdag nyid kyis/ / dbang bskur sngon du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bri ba rnal 'byor pas ni nor 'dzin bgegs dang skyon/ sbyangs/ / lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa 'bad pas hūm̐ las rdo rje can | | phyag gnyis pa/ byas te phyi nas sbyangs nas/ dkyil 'khor bri/ / gnas tshal 'di'ang sa chog tu bsdu gsung*/ dang skye bo med gnas dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i khyim rnams dang*/ dzo ki khang yang na dbang bskur ba'i khang pa rnying pa/ stong dang ni khyim nang du/ / thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa rgyal pos/ bzhengs par bya/ /rdul tshon dam pa nyid dang ni/ /yang na 'bring po nyid kyis te/ /rin chen lnga yi bdag nyid phyes// yang na 'bras la sogs pas bri/

/ mi bskyod pa'i/ dkyil 'khor tshad ngos re la/ khru gsum bya ba dang*/ /mthe bong gsum ni lhag par bya/ /1'og nas 'byung ba'i 'dod yon lnga'i sogs 'di shes/ 2'di grub pa dang 'brel ba/ 3dkyil 'khor der ni rigs lnga las byung ba'i | | lhan skyes skye ba'i rten du rung ba rig mchod pa la yang dgos/ ma bzang mo gzhug par dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la dgos pas so/ bya/ / 1slob dpon gyi dbang nod pa/ 2brtag pa gnyis par mi gsal ba gsal bas so/ /3'dir slob ma smin par byed pa la dang por slob dpon rang nyid nyes pas ma gos pa rang dag par byed pa'i tshul ston sngags kyi smin/ lam ni dbang bskur ba'i cho gas/ rjes btsal bas/ /gang tshe de kho na nyid shes pa'i/ mkhas pas shi ri sha dbang sngon du bdag gis| bskur ba/ / 'i tshe na/ sangs rgyas lnga/ kun gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du/ mngon sum du/ / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dngos su bris pa der/ bde bar gshegs gnas su// der|ting nge 'dzin gyi 'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa'i ta thā ga tā/ bdag / blo dang ldan pas slob ma la dbang bskur ba bzhin/ dbang bzhi po de bzhin blangs/ / slob ma la dbang ji ltar bskur tshul rang bdag nyid lha la dbang nos pas rang gi sku gsung thugs dri ma dang bral ba thob/ byin brlab pa'i gnas thob pa'i rjes la rim pa 'khrugs pas slob ma la dbang bskur na| nas/ /dam tshig nyams pas rtsa ltung bcu gnyis par 'gro bas/ 'jigs pa yis/ / spyir slob ma dbang bskur la bskul bar gsungs pa yang drang don lta bu ma yin te/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis don dam phyin ci ma log par ston par byed pa'i rgyud/ nges pa'i rgyud las las/ / smin par byed pa'i sngag sa kyi lam ni de bzhin rim pa ji lta ba bzhin/ slob ma la dbang bskur bar gsungs | | de ltar dbang bskur gyi rim pa ma 'khrugs par bskur ba/ ma bskur na rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs lha'i/

/dam tshig rim pa shin tu ring*/ / bas ma 'khrugs par bskur ro/ 1de bzhin zer/2slob ma la dbang bskur dgos pa/3 'di dag dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa sngon du bya'o de phyir rang gzhan gyi/ don la kun 'bad pas/ / gsol ba gdab/ dbang bskur ba'i/ don du/ rgyal ba'i bdag nyid dang 'dra bar/ skyes/ / pa'i/ rdo rje slob dpon yon tan mtsho/ / de la 'og gi mchod bstod byas la/ ji lta ba/ bzhin gyi tshogs/ gsol ba gdab pa'i sho lo ka'i sbyor bas gsol ba mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas/ gdab/ / de'i rjes la slob dpon gyi/ bram ze ma yang na gar/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang mchod pa'i rten bstan pa ste gong gi der ni rigs lnga sogs kyi rgyas bshad ma dang sring mo dang*/ma'i thu mo/ / ste ma'i spun/ gdol pa mo/ cha bu sring mo yi bu mo nyid// ces pa chad 'dra brtag zhu dag pa'i mchan ཾ 'di rnams kyi/ nang nas/ gang bde ji lta bar/ / de dag dang rnyed lha la gsang gtor bya ba dang*/ bdag dang rnal 'byor ma rnams bdud rtsi myang ba dang*/ nang gi sbyin sreg bya ba'i phyir/ nas dkyil 'khor/ bsgrub pa nyid du rigs la blang dor med pas/ gyis// 'byor pas ma rnyed de bstan pa la gnod pa sogs yin na yang na mngon du 'di med na/ / ye shes kyi phyag rgya la bsgrub pa bstan kun mkhyen gyis bsngags rig pa'i/ ma ni/ / 'dir slob ma smin par byed pa la snying kha nas sprul pa'i bdag med ma/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis khyad par du bsngags pa| mdzad pa/ / de la brten nas bsgrub pa 'di ni de phyir bzung bar bya/ / 1rab du rgyas par bstan|2 rnyed nas/ 3 phyag rgya'i rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas bstan skye ba gnyis 4 ta thā ga ta'i rigs/ kyi bu mo dang*/ yang na btso blag ma las kyi rigs/ dang*/ yang na rat+na'i rigs/ gdol pa mo dang*/ rdo rje g.yung mo dang*/ rigs rdo rje/ las skyes ma dang*/ yang na ra'i/ rgyal mo dang | te rgyal po'i bu mo/

gar mkhan pad+ma'i rigs/ gyi bu mo dang*/ bzo mo lham mkhan/ dang*/ spyir dbang dus su lang tsho/ lam dus rigs/ 'bras bu'i dus su yon tan gtso gsung ngo yang na ri de dag gi mtshan nyid/ dwags kyi mig che ba/ ma dang*/ sked pa phra ba dang*/ ro smad rgyas pa dang | rgas kyang mi nub nu ma mtho ba dang*/ skyes pa'i skyon mi 'byung ba ste bsten yang skyes pa mi 'chi bas bha ga bzang ba dang*/ dam tshig mtha' dag gi spyod pa la shin tu dam pa 'di thams cad sbyangs pa las byung ba'i yon tan/ dang*/ de kho na nyid rtogs pa la rgyun du/ la gnas pa dang | snga gas bzlas pa/ dang rgyud kyi don dam gzugs bsgyur ba/ shes pa ste sgrub pa po'i dbang po la gnas gsum du che ba'i bu mo 'di dag dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la sogs pa'i ched du bsten par/ bshad do/ / bram ze mo la sogs pa'i rigs dang mthun par bsten pa/ rigs kyi rim pa nyid kyis yo gi 'di rnams kyis thams cad sid+dhi gnyis/ 'grub par 'gyur ro// rigs dang mthun pa'i mu dra ma rnyed ji ltar gang rnyed de/ /de bzhin bcu drug lon pa nyid | | dang po skyes pa dang ma phrad pa/ dbang dus lang tsho phun sum tshogs/ /mig mdzes phyag rgya rnyed nas ni/ / rnyed ma thag tu bsgrub bam zhe na ma yin te rig ma de nyid blangs nas ni | | snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir skyabs su gsum sngon du/ 'gro ba la sogs pa gsum pa dang gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi/ ba'i rim pas ni/ / dbang gis rgyud sbyangs nas de nyid la| gsang ba 'i don/ dang*/ / snying po la sogs pa'i sngags dang bya ba dang spyod pa la sogs pa'i| rgyud ( kyi ) rim pa la zer/ kun bsgrags/ / gsang rtsa btsal bar bya ba/ kha kha mu kha sgra'am 'og gi lam du pad+ma/ rdo rjes lces/ / 1bskyod pa/ 2de lta bu dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i dus su dal bar rgyu ba'i rlung ha dang si'i rnam par grags pa/ shu kra de mahā su kha/ nyid de bzhin steng du

1dbang gi gnas su/ 2dang po srin lag gi sen mo med par byas te gzhugade nas rdo rje nyid gzhug / kun gyi cha 'i sbyor ba shes/ rig bcu drug sogs/ de nyid byed/ / rig ma'i rim sbyor thabs brla dang kam pa sogs lnga'o/ / pa nyid kyis rna cha dang*/ / ske rags che dang se mo do/ / 'jig rten pa dang mthun pa'i rus pa'i rkang gdub dang ni lag gdub ldan/ / pa de dang snyoms par zhugs pas dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang mchod par bya'o/ /yang na 'di rnams kyis bla ma mnyes par bya ba'i phyir phyag rgya dbul ba'i phyag rgya yang bstan to/ de dag rten de 'di rtsa ba'i rgyud du ma tshang ba kha bskang*| ltar dngos grub dgos pa/ dam pa ster/ ba'i mu dra/ gang 'bul ba gang zhig rgyud smin par| sbyangs snod rung du byas/ pa'i rig ma kun/ / dbul te/ gnas gang du nye skye bo snod min med pas| bar 'tshe ba med pa'i gnas su/ / yul lnga la dbul rig slob dpon/ pa 'dzin pa 'khor mang po/ / dang ldan pa la/ mu tra de de nas tsan dan gos phreng sogs/ /rnam par brgyan nas dbul bar bya/ / pū tsa gzhan yang dri dang phreng sogs rim gro yi/ /'o ma'i chang*| mchod bstod dang*/ sogs rgyas pa yi/ /phyag rgya dang*/ thabs cig tu zhugs pa'i slob dpon la/ sgrub pa pos/ / rdo rje slob dpon yon tan mtsho la gus par 'bad pas sgrub pa po'i zhu bde dang dbang gi zhu bde gnyis ka 'dra/ yang dag mchod/ /slob mas pus mo legs par ni zer te min/ 'i lha nga ni/ /sa la dad pas btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas bstod pa 'dis/ /ston pa la ni zhu bar bya/ / mchog dbang gsum gyi sngon du yang bstod pa 'di bya stong 1kun nas nyon mongs pa mi rgyu bas rnam snang gi yon tan/ 2slob dpon de la gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po dang ldan pas/ pa'i snying po phyag 'tshal bstod/ / gzung ba dang 'dzin la sogs pa'i rtog gang gis bstod na/ pa thams cad yang dag spangs/

/ pa'i chas/ ye shes kyi chas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshogs/ / don rnam snang gi sgo nas bstod ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / snang mtha' 'gro ba'i mi shes shes bya'i sgrib pa/ gcod pa can/ / gang la ci 'dul de la de'i chos bstan pa'i sgo nas dag pa'i de kho na/ nyid ston par| mdzad pa/ / dag pa'i chos gang zhe na bdag med chos las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal gsung gis don mdzad pa'i sgo nas/ bstod/ /rdzogs rin 'byung*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub gzhan don dngos kyi sgo nas bstod/ sems/ /pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan rnams/ /mgon po las ni rtag tu 'byung*/ /byang chub las thams cad 'byung ba dang 'dra bar bla ma las kyang dngos grub thams cad 'byung bas/ sems dang 'dra ba yon tan nam dngos grub thams cad 'byung bas/sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad pas/

la phyag 'tshal bstod | | mi bskyod dkon mchog gsum gyi yang ngo bo/ dang theg pa/ chen po/ dang*/ / dharmā'i yang ngo bo/ de bzhin bstan dang 'gro ba dang*/ khams gsum po ni 'di dag kun/ / gyi bdag nyid du/ 'gro ba'i nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las rgyal bas/ dpa' bo phyag 'tshal kun 'gro'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa'i sgo nas/ bstod/ /yid bzhin nor bu ltar don grub/ gyur pa'i/ / phrin las sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i 'dod pa'i don bsgrub phyir/ /dpal ldan bde gshegs bka' bzhin mdzad/ / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad nas sangs rgyas sras po phyag 'tshal sku'i don mdzad pa'i sgo nas/ bstod/ / gsol gdab de nyid bla med rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyu| bdag 'tshal bas//yon tan 'byung ba'i mdzod/ mtsho dang 'dra/ khyod bka' drin las// slob ma'i ngo gang la kun mkhyen dang 'dra bas kun mkhyen thob par byed pa'am des gsungs pa'i/ rdo rje'i dbang gis ni/ /da lta nyid du bka' drin skyobs/ / rigs lnga dang drug pa sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i sgo nas bla ma la rigs drug gi sgo nas bstod pa gsungs/ kun gyi gsang ba ni/ / ji ltar dpal thugs bzhugs zer/ sngon gyi bud+dhas rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje chos can shāka thub| la gsungs pa/ /de bzhin mgon pos bdag bsgrub mdzod/ /bcom ldan dang 'dra ba'i bla ma khyed kyi/zha bas pad spangs nas ni/ /gzhan du bdag la 'gro bka' drin nod pa/ ma mchis/ / dam tshig can tshogs la spyan drangs pa gsum mo 'khor ba'i 'gro las nges rgyal bar/ /de phyir mgon po thugs rjes mdzod/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon dpal | | gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ rjes su snying rjes/ brtse bcas byams pa/ phan sems kyis | | slob la snying rje bskyed nas ni/ / tshig 'di dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug gi tshul gyis bsgrub pa dang tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor

hūm̐ las dbang gi lha mdun du/ dgug pa dang*/ / gnas der 'di dag sngar byas zin 'dod yon lnga yis gang ba dang*/ /bla re bres pas nyer 'bar bar/ / phyi rnal 'byor ma dang sbyor ldan zhing*/ / dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad dril bu gsil gsil sgra dang ni/ /me tog dang*/ bdug spos/ 'khyil ba/ nyams dga' ba/ /lha yi dri dang*/ phreng bde ba de lta bu la brten nas/ mchog / bskyed pa/ dpal ldan rdo rje sems sogs lha'i | | dkyil 'khor mchog tu ngo mtshar bar/ /slob dpon skal ba de kho na nyid rtogs pa bzang po mchog / gis/ de nas phyag rgya dang*/ sbyor byas nas/ / dkyil 'khor bsgrub ste dbyung*/ snyoms 'jug gi sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa bkug 'od du zhu ba'i zhes pa la sogs pa/ rgyal ba'i bdag skyes byang chub sems/ /pad+ma'i snod du gzhug par 1de nas pu tsam mchod/ 2des dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bsang gtor bya/ bdag nyid kyang myang bya/ / la dkyil 'khor la mchod/ rnga yab bdag nyid 'jug slob ma gzhug g.yob cing gdugs dang ni/ / bkra shis tshigs bcad glu rnams sngon du song nas/ kyi/ /phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis| ldan pas slob ma de/ / la la 'di gsang ba'i dbang du byed/ de ni ma yin te 'dir gsang ba ni yab kyi rdo rje dang yum gyi pad+ma nas len gyi/ ka la shar bzhag la blangs pa ni 'dus pa'i lugs so/ /yang 'og rang nas kyang gsang dbang bstan pa'i phyir 'di ma yin 'gro chu nas bum dbang rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ ba'i gco bos slob dpon gyi/ dbang bskur bya/ / 'di yang le'u bcu pa'i dbang gi le'u'i ma tshang ba kha bskang*/ de nyid bcu shes pa'i slob dpon mchog gi dbang phyug gis/ / de la dam tshig sbyin zhing sdom pa bsgrags pa/ dbang ni rin chen rig dbang lnga/ drug pa dang*/bum pa/ rjes gnang gnyis te brgyad do/ / mchog byin nas/ / sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bzang po'i chang*/ rang bzhin

bdud rtsir/ legs sbyangs pa'i/ / bcud len ḍā kīs byin brlabs/ bsrung ba/ spyod pa la goms|'da' bar mi bya bas dam tshig yid 'ong nges par sbyin/ / de nyid bstan pa khrag rang byung*| chen dang ni gu pur shu kra/ bcas/ / sha chen tsan dan dmar po sbyar ba dang*/ / rigs kyi bdag dri chu/ po chu ldan zhing*/ /lnga dri chen/ pa sems kyi snang ba yin pa/ las yang dag byung*/ /'di rnams dam tshig yang dag par/ / thun mtshams su byas na/ rtogs rim gyi zhi ba'i dngos grub 'byung ngo sangs rgyas rnams kyis nye bar gsungs/ /bzang po zhes bos nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ rtag tu bskyang bar gyis/ / bsrung ba'i sdom pa yang ni da lta nyon | | bsrung ba la sdom par gsungs srog gtso bo gsum bstan/ chags gsad par gnyis par 'gro bas/ mi bya zhing*/ / bcu bzhi par 'gro bas bud med rin chen yongs mi spang*/ / dang por 'gro bas des ni slob dpon spang mi bya/ / 'di gsum gyis mtshon nas bcu bzhi po mtha' dag sdom pa gsum po/ shin tu 'da' zer/ spyad par dka'/ / ma tshang ba kha bskang gong mchod sogs sngon du song nas gsang dbang ston/ du gsungs pa'i rig ma skye gnyis kyi bu mo la sogs pa/ 'am/ /yang na bdag gi rigs dang mthun pa'i/ rnal 'byor ma/ / rgyud dag pa las lhar bskyed pa dag mchod sogs sngon du song bas/ cing sprul pa'i rig ma ni/ /si h+la ga pur bsgos pa ni/ / phyag rgyas de ji srid khu ba dang*/ ldan par/ gyur pa/ / brtag pa dang po'i le'u bcu pa'i don gsal bar bstan/ gsang dbang gi rdzas btsal ba de srid kyi bar du/ phyag rgya bsten par bya/ / gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i dus su ngo tsha ba spang ba'i phyir/ phyag rgya'i gdong gsang ba'i yum| yang bcing ba dang*/ / slob ma thabs kyi gdong yang de bzhin te/ / gsang ba'i yab kyis gsang ba'i yum bsten pas yang dag gang byung ba/ / 'i shu kra gsang dbang gi de kho na ltar yang bshad slob ma'i kha ru ltung bar

rgyud phyi ma ltar lus bstan/ de nas gdong phye ste bshad pa bya bya/ / len lugs lnga/ 1gsang dbang gi dus su bde ba chen po ston pa/2gang la brten nas de bskur ba ro mchod sogs sngon du song nas/ mnyam slob ma'i spyod yul nyid/ / du bya ba'i phyir/ rten gang la brten nas she na de gsang ba'i yum/ nyid la ni rig ma gcig gi dbang rdzogs pa'i lugs yin gsung*| bya bar bya/ / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi nyams myong bskyed/ de'i mtshan nyid brgyad ldan rang rig ye shes nyid du 'gyur/ / don rgyas par 'og nas dbang cho ga 'dis sbyin par bya zhing zhes rgyas par ro/ / rang dang*/ gzhan du zhen pa'i rtog pa/ yang dag rig pa spangs/ / spros pa dang bral ba/mi rtog pa de mkha' dpe'i nyams/ mnyam rtog pa'i/ rdul bral stong pa nyid/ / shu kra dngos gnyis su med pa yin/ dang mi rtog pa/ dngos med rang rig bdag nyid dbyer med bde ba| mchog / myong ba'i g.yung mo/ khu ba thabs dang u tsi ta/ shes bde ba/ rab rnam pra tsi ta| par 'dres/ / u tsi ta 'dod chags pra tsi ta/ 'dod chags bral ba dbang gi gnas su/ 'dres | | de nyid rang rig pa'i bdag nyid yin pas/ srogs chags rnams kyi 'tsho bar byed pa yin| slob ma'i nyams myong gi ngo gang la rang bzhin lhan skyes cig tu byed pa dang 'dra/ srog /de nyid a k+ṣa ra/ yi ge dam pa rtogs par mi 'gyur bas/ nyid/ / mi 'gyur ba yin/ lhan skyes de nyid 'di ni brtan g.yo/ kun khyab byed/ / thams cad la khyab pa yin/ de nyid sangs rgyas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin/ ye shes can// yi ge bzhi'i don dang ldan pas he ru ka dpal zhes byar bshad// thams cad kyi rgyu yin gzhan dbang po drug rnams gang rnams brtan/ de rnams g.yo/ dang*/ / shu kra dngos snang*/ dang mi rtog pa dngos stong*/ med de las sa ha dza/ byung*/ / le'u brgyad pa dang cha mthun par bstan dga' shes rab ye shes kyi dus su dga' ba bzhi'i mngon par rtogs pas de bstan/

ba dang po ra byung bas/ dpa' bo skyes pa dang 'dra/ skye tshul gyi ste/ / phyi rol gyi 'o sogs mchog tu dga' ba rnal bā+o la kak+ko la mnyam par sbyar ba tsam na gong ma bas mchog tu gyur bas/ 'byor ma// dang 'dra/ shin tu bde dga' thams cad phyi rol gyi 'dod pa dang bral la/ nang gi bde ba la 'dod par/ nges/ /de bde'i gsum po/ thabs gsum po lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo/ las sa ha dza mngon du byas tsam na/ thams cad nyams myong che chung gi sgo nas/ rig /dang po dga' mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa gsum par dga' bral skye zhing*/ bzhi pa la lhan cig skyes pa skye ba ste/ lhan cig skyes pa gsum par 'dod pa ni slob ma'i slob dpon gyi dgongs pa dang 'gal lo/ / ba tsam nyid de/ / mchog tu dga' ba che/ gnyis pa'i grangs/ /gsum pa dga' bral mi rtog tsam/ zhes byar bshad/ / dbang gi gnas su bzhi pa lhan cig skyes par mtshon bya/ brjod/ / le'u gsum pa gleng gzhi'i le'u dang cha mthun par ston/ dang po'i brgyad pa dang*/ bcu pa/ phyi ma'i gsum pa bsdoms nas de de'i mtshon byed dbang bzhi/ grangs go rim mam dri ma 'khrud par mthun pas bzhir/ yang dbang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /dang po la ni bum pa'i dbang*/ /gnyis pa la ni gsang ba'i dbang*/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ / 70 01 cha don gcig ཾ ma tshang bas kha bskang bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ / de'i phan yon byang chub zhi bde tha mi dad/ sems kyi shes rab ye shes kyi/ dbang gis ni/ /slob ma sdig pa bde ba chen po mngon du byas pa mi rtog bzhin rtog pa/ bral ba nyid/ / de nas rjes gnang sbyin pa sangs dkyil 'khor 'gram du dbang bskur nas| rgyas grong khyer mchog sngon du/ /de nas de la rjes su/ gnang ba sbyin/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /phyogs bcu/ kun tu dus gsum po/ ni 'khor lo ni/ / rgyud sde bzhi ka'i chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ /kun tu mchog tu rab tu bskor/

/ mi dmigs pa'i snying rje thabs dang mi dmigs pa'i/ shes rab rang bzhin bdag / mi rtog bzhin yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas/ / 'dod don bsgrubs/ zhen med du don byed pas/ sbyor sems can don/ med bral te don byed la/ zhing don byed pa la/ ma zhum pas/ / dbang thob pas don grub pas gzhan don bya ba sems can don ni da lta gyis/ / slob ma'i bya ba'i rim pa dbang dang bkas rjes/ gnang thob nas ni/ / dbang bskur nos pas/ bya ba byas pas rab 'dzum zhing | | don dga' bar byed pa'i rgyu yi 'gro ba dga' bar byed pa yi/ /shin tu snyan pa'i tshig 'di brjod/ / dbang bskur ba'i deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gi 'tsho ba ma shi ba/ 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed pas/ rigs su skyes | | da ni sangs rgyas kyi gdung 'tshob pas/ rigs su gyur/ / sngar bskal pa rgya mtsho 'jigs chen por/ /mnar med skye ba yang dag rgyud/ 'khrugs/ / de'i rgyu nyon mongs 'dam dpag rgal dka' las/ /bdag ni mgon po khyod kyis bsgral/ khyod kyi zhabs pad bka' drin las/ / gdams ngag thos thob zer te min/ pa rdzogs pa 'i sangs rgyas| lta bur bdag / dbang bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags thams cad shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ bral bas na/ /bdag la ma thob pa thob par bgyi ba'i| byang chub 'tshal ma mchis/ / pa lta bur gyur kyang*/ /gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dbang thob pas rangs shing mig ni phye ba yis/ /zhabs la 'jus nas gus par bya/ /gang dang gang zhig sdug pa'i rdzas/ / lan la/ re ba med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /de dang de nyid dbul bar bya/ /bla ma'ang snying rje ldan pas ni/ /slob ma bsdu ba'i la chos bshad pa/ bsam pa'i phyir/ /da ེ'i rgyud/ la tshogs bsags pa/ phan pa'i phyir yang zungs/ / de nas phyag 'tshal mchod nas ni/ /bla ma la ni yon rnams dbul/ /gser ni stong phrag brgya dang ni/ /rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/

/gos ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang*/ / gla nga po rta dang yul 'khor nyid/ /rna cha dang ni rkang gdub dang*/ / nor bu dang ni sor gdub mchog /gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ / rang gi chung ma bu mo dang*/ /bran pho bran mo sring mo nyid/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni dbul bar bya/ /bdag gi rdzas kyi/ dngos po thams cad kyis/ /blo dang ldan pas bla ma la/ dbul/ / la mchod/ med na/ de ring tshun chad bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags zhes/ /de ltar zhu ba byas gyur pas/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i gnas go 'phang shes rab ye shes/ thob nas/ /da ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ / bdag ni bka' drin legs par skyobs/ /ji ltar bla med byang chub de/ / shes rab dang ye shes kyi/ byin gdams ngag gyis brlabs kyi bdag gis bsgrubs/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang*/ gnas/ /kun gyi/ mchog tu gyur pa/ mchod pa bskyed par bgyi | | sa nas/ sems can gnas gsum spyod pa rnams/ /de kho na/ nyid la ni bzhag par bgyi/ / 1shes rab ye shes kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi nyams myong dang*/ rang lha dang tha mi dad pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes tha mi dad snyam pa 'byung gsung 2ma tshang ba kha bskang 3rtsa bar mi galas ba gsal bar dbang cho ga 'dis bzhi pa'i dbang bskur ba/ sbyin par bya zhing mchod bstod gsol gdab sngon du song nas/ slob ma'i shes rab ye shes kyi don la/ lhag par mos pa dang*/ shes par byas la/ slob ma zab pa dang rdzogs pa la mos na lhan skyes/ shes rab ye shes bskyed pa la mos na bskyed pa dag pa dang bcas pa bstan/ rgya che ba la mos par/ rig bskyed pa la mos pa/ pas lhag par mtshan ma'i rtags las/ mos pa yid kyis shes par byas nas tshig nyid kyi/ 'dod pa'i don bsgrub pas dbang de ltar dbang gsum pa'i nyams su myong ba dang mthun par phyis khyod rang gi mi nyams par lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams rgyud la bskyed la sems can gyi don byos zhes pa'o//

rin po che bzhi pa sbyin par bya'o/ / shes rab ye shes gang thob dbang rab mchog gi gnas| rigs kyi mdzes spyi/ bdag po 'i rtse/ ra bzung ba 'i man ngag rnyed par de/ dka' zhing byang sems sdom pa'i thabs/ mtshungs pa dbab/ bzung*/ zlogakhyab par bya/ mi nyams par bsrung*/ med pas mi 'chor bar/ bsdams/ / bde ba la longs kha snar/ spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing mdzes spyi/ gi dpal zhu bde/ dag blangs par byas pas yab yum kyi byang sems 'dra ba la bu tis| byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i zhu bde tha mi dad mngon du byas pas shes rab ye shes kyi/ dbang bskur ba/ / de nas dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod bya zer/ bka' yi gnang ba rjes su gdams pa bstan pa/

rnyed ces pa man chad kyi dag pa bstan pa/ 'di man chad kyis sems can don bya tshul snyam/ nas 'jig rten lha chen po/ gsum gyi nyon mongs pa'i/ dgra bo las rgyal de thob par bya ba'i phyir/ brtson pa'i go bgos pa yi blos/ / gzhan don gyi snying rjes byang sems can thams cad/ chub kyi/ bdag nyid/ la dgod pa'i sems pas/ rgyas 'dir ni de kho na/ nyid rnal 'byor pas sems can du ma zhen pa'i blos/ ni dri ma med par 'di dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod dam shes rab ye shes kyi dus su spyod/ de nas gdams ngag rdzogs par byin na bla ma'i dam tshig nyams| de nas nyams rgyud la ma bskyed na dbang gi bka' 'chad pa rgyud la bskyed do*/ byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ba ste/ gnyis pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// // 1sna tshogs su snang zhing bskyed 2su tsaka 3brtag gnyis kyi le'u lnga par rang bzhin lhan skyes bsgom pa'i tshul gang phyir yid kyi zhes pa la sogs pa'i don/ tshul ji ltar bsgom pa dang*/ bsgom pa'i phan yon mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa dang*/ dam tshig sgyu ma tsam du shes pa dang*/ bsgom pa'i 'thad pa rnams mi gsal ba gsal ba'i tshul du bshad/ yang le'u brgyad pa dang le'u lnga pa'i phyag rgya la brten pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bskyed byed ma zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i don mi gsal ba gsal bar bshad de/ phyag rgya bsten pa'i gnas/ bsten pa'i tshul/ lam thabs/ rten nyid gang la bya ba ste de yum bzhir bsgom pa/ mdor na ma bsten pa'i nyes pa la sogs pa'i tshul du bshad do/ /mdor na rnal 'byor bla na med pa thams cad du dmigs pa med pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi thabs shes rab bsgom pa'i tshul dang*/ phyag rgya la brten pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa tsam gyi don gsal bar byed do/ / de nas sgrub pa po/ thabs dang ni ra tsaka shes phyag rgya/ rab spros pa dang bral ba don/ / rang gi ngo bo/ 1de las byung ba'i sa ha dza 2mnyam rjes med par

bsgom pa yang 'bar 'dzag tshul gyi dag mtha' gsum dang bral ba'i tshul gyis gang ltar yang mi bsgom pa'i tshul gyi rab gsang zhing sba ba'i tshul gyis/ bshad bya/ / dgos pa/ pha rol gyi| don la/ brtson pa'i/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i tshul/ kyi/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir | | dmigs su med pa/ bsam du med pa'i don bsgoms pa las phan yon ci 'byung na/ rgyu'i gnas skabs na rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa bsgoms pas myang 'das kyi mtha' la mi gtan te gzhan don 'byung*/ rang gi ngo bos bzung ba dang bral bar bsgoms pas sangs rgyas kyi stobs sogs thob pas 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas te/ de lta bu'i dgos pa yod do/ / 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'jigs pa las/ /bsgral dka' sgrol bar byed pa/ gang zhig gtso bor dmigs pa med pa/ thabs shes rab kyi don rnam bsgom pa/ /rnal 'byor snying rje dang shes rab/ pas ni rang don du/ / gzhan don du 'khor ba mi spong pas mtha' gnyis la mi gnas par bstan mya ngan 'das par gnas mi 'gyur/ / thabs shes rab kyi don rang rig pa'i dag pa bsgoms pas gang gi khyad nyan thos kyi myang 'das las/ stobs sogs/ 'phags mthar thug par/ /sangs rgyas shes rab kyis 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pas/ dri med mtha' gnyis kyi skyon gyis ma gos pas/ ngo mtshar rmad/ / mi mthun pa 'grib dang gnyen po/ 'phel las skye 'gag dang bral/ rnam par grol/ / de lta bu'i bsam du med pa'i don de bsgom pa las mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i byang chub bla med thob par 'gyur/ / rjes sgyu ma tsam du shes pa nyid kyis mi gtsang ba la mi smad pa phung po lnga sangs rgyas lnga yin pa/ sogs chos drug pa/ ltung ba brgyad pa dang rnams dang*/ / gdul bya la ji ltar spangs dka' bas theg gsum drug pa/ shin tu spang mi bya/ / 1ci ste mi spang zhe na 2chos thams cad kyi chos kyi/ dbyings su don dam pa rtogs pa'i dus/ shin gdul bya'i don du cir yang 'byung bas/

tu mnyam pa nyid/ / yin pas|snying po med pa ci'ang med pa yin zhes nyi tshe ba'i chu kun rdzob tu snang la rang bzhin med pa'am/ shing lta bur yongs su bzung*/ / bsam du med pa tshul ji ltar bsgom pa ste don dag pa rnam pa gsum las rang rig pa'i dag pa yin pas stong pa ste/ de bzhin nyid kyi dag pas stong pa'i rnam par bsgom par mi bya la stong pa de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ bsgom par mi bya ste/ / 1dngos por yod 2'o na spong ngam zhe na 3spyir yul dang yul can gnyis las/ yul shes bya la gnas lugs grub pa med pas yul can gyi shes pa gzung du med do/ /de la yul la gnas lugs 'dod na skyon bzhi yod de/ gnas med na yod pas/ yod na med pas lugs la gnod pa yod pa dang*/ nges pa ma ltos par blo yul du pa blo yul du mi rung ba dang*/ blo la blo la ma ltos pa'i shes bya 'dod na dbang phyug kyang dgag par mi nus par 'gyur/ma ltos pa mi rigs pa dang*/ mthar bzung 'dzin na srid pa'i rtsa ba/na srid pa'i rtsa bar 'gyur ba dang*/ gnas lugs yod na lta bar 'gyur bas des sman ma zhu ba dug lta bu/ na skyon du 'gyur ro stong min te lha'i dag pa tsam du'ang*| bsgom par mi bya'o/ / lan du stong pa rang rig pa'i dag pa/ mi spangs sus mi spang na/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa rnal 'byor pas/ /rtog pa ba sal ba stong rang rig pa'i rgyu ma 'gags pa| min yongs su mi spang ngo*/ / 'o na gong gi stong dang stong min bsgom pa la skyon ci yod ce na stong nyi tshe ba'i/ dang stong min dngos po med par/ bzung ba las/ / sgro 'dogs pa dang skur pa'i/ rtog pa nyung min skye bar 'gyur/ / stong pa spangs nas stong min du bzung na rtog pa yin la/ stong min spangs te stong par bzung na yang skur 'debs kyi rtog pa yin pas yongs 'o na stong dang stong min spang ngam zhe na su spangs na kun rtog ste/ /de phyir

yod med kyi rtog pa/ de gnyis yongs su spangs | | stong pa dang stong min du 'dzin pa gnyis spong ba gnyis kyi bzung ba yongs spangs pa | | 'i rang rig pa'i dag pa/ rnam grol rgyud kha cig las bgrod zer/ gnas dang bral ba ste// tha na da ni ci'ang mi bsgom zhes par 'dzin na yang*/ nga zhes bya ba'i kun rtog 'di/ / grol ba ni 'dzin pa dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir dang 'dzin pa las rtog pa skye ba'i phyir de phyir de kho na nyid spyod pa'i rtog pa yin pas zhen pa'o/ 'di ni yang dag spangs// 1zhen pa'i 2gnyen po spyod pa 3chos thams cad stong nyid rnam pa med cing ltung*/ 'khor ba las te 'bras bu mi thob snyam pa'i dogs pa med/ / 'bras bu la 'dod pa med cing rgyu rtog pa dang bral bas/ sdig pa bral/ /thog ma skye ba/ tha ma'i 'gag pa dang dbus gnas pa/ rtog pa/ las grol/ / bas/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bas na nam rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa/ mkha' lta bur mkhas pas chos thams cad | bsgom/ / 1dmigs pa med pa'i/2bcu gsum pa'i 3bsam du med pa'i don bsgom pa'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ don gyis na 'di bsgom pa'i 'bras bu'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i snying rje dang shes rab thob pa'i rgyu yin pas sgom shig par gdams pa'o/ / snying rje ldan pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid bstan/ sems can la/ / nyan thos ltar rgyab kyis phyogs par mi bya zhing | | byed pa'i snying rje 'di ni don bya rgyu'i sems can byed bzhin du mi dmigs pa/ yod dang yod min zhes/ /de ltar yongs su brtag par| mi bya/ / zung 'jug spros pa rtog pa/ med pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /shes rab ces ni rab tu grags/ /yid bzhin nor ltar ma lus pa'i/ / mi rtog bzhin thams cad don byed snying rje nyid/ /dmigs med go 'phang du/ gnas su shes rab dang*/ /dmigs med snying rje chen po nyid/ / de bzhin nyid kyi

blo ye shes/ dang lhan cig dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang shes rab/ gcig gyur pas// dmigs med kyi snying rje dang shes rab gnyis ldog pa'i tshul gyi phye ba las ngo bo zag med kyi ye shes gcig yin pas na nam mkhar nam mkha' ji lta ba'o/ / 1de lta bu'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir bsgom par 'thad 2'o na gnyis med ye shes bya ba bsgom dgos zhe na 'di nyid yin par bstan 3bsam du med pa'i don 4de mtha' gang gis kyang ma reg pa'i tshul gyis spyod lam thams cad du bsgoms shig par gdams pa gang la sgom pa po gang med/ /gang yang rnam par sgom pa'ang ting nge 'dzin/ med// sgom par/ bya ba/ nyid kyang yod min pa/ / gsum po dang bral ba de yi de kho na/ nyid bsam mi khyab kyi/ sgom par brjod/ / bde ba bskyed pa'i thabs shes rab tu zhen pa gang yang bya ba spang bya spang ba'i bya ba dang gnyen po bskyed pa dang 'bras bu thob byar zhen pa'i bya ba/ yod min 'dir// bsgom bya bza' bya nyid kyang yod ma yin/ /byed po bza' ba po dang bsgom bya/ las rnam par grol/ / gsum po dang bral bas don dam de lta bu'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir bsgom par 'thad pa bstan| rnam par bsgoms pas ni/ /'di la sgrub po gang yang med/ /gang yang 'bras bu la/ gtod par bya ba med/ /dor ba ra zhen pa/ cung zad med par brjod// gnyen po blangs ba ra zhen pa/ 'ang 'di cung zad/ la yod ma yin/ / dmigs pa med pa'i ye shes de| snang thams cad du snang yang grub cir yang ma grub pas dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang*/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu 'dra ba dang*/ / de thams cad gnyis med ye shes bstan 'phrog pa zla ba'i grong mtshungs dang*/ / byang chub sems rmi brjod du med pa/ lam gyi/ rtse da mo/ ba lta bur blta/ / snang yang mi zhen pas sgyu ma ji bzhin de dag snang yang mi zhen pa'i bzhin/ thams cad du/ /blta ba nyid dang reg par bya/ / ba dang*/ 'gro ba kun gyi gnas pa ni/

/ rang bzhin gang yang 'di lta bu zhes/ rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ / sna tshogs su snang zhing bskyed pas thabs/rang bzhin gyi spros pa dang bral bas shes rab sbyor thabs shes rab/ ba'i 'dus par bsam mi khyab/ / dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba 'dra gsungs na/ lkugs pa'i rmi lam sad pa lta bur ni/ /ji ltar gzhon nu mas myong yang brjod par mi nus pa/ 'i gzugs kyis ni/ / de'i mtshon byed dbang po yang na sna tshogs su bskyed pas thabs/ rtog pa dang bral bas shes rab/ gnyis ni 'dus pa yi/ /bha gar ling ga bzhag nas ni/ / mi rtog pa skyes pa de sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa gang ltar yang mi bsgom pa'i tshul gyis/ bsgom/ /ye shes ci zhig skye zhe na/ / skye ba'i rtog pa thog ma gnas pa'i dbus mtha' 'gag pa'i rtog pa/ dri ma med/ /rang gi rig pa'i ye shes de/ / so sor rang gis rig par bya ba las gzhan du smra bar mi nus pa'i phyir bsgom par 'thad pas/ so/ / 1bsgom pa'i dus su 2shes pa'i rgyu ba dgag mi dgos/ gzugs rnams thams cad blta ba dus skabs/thams cad du skye bar bstan/ dang*/ /sgra rnams nyid kyang nyan pa dang | | smra ba dang ni rgod pa dang*/ /sna tshogs ro ni za ba dang*/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa na/ / rnam pa de dag gi rnam par snang yang ngo bo dmigs pa med pa'i don las gzhan du sems ni mi 'gro bas/ /de kho na/ nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ / mnyam rjes med par rnal 'byor rtag tu skye bar 'gyur/ / ba'i phyir bsgom par 'thad/ 1ming gi rnam grangs kyi sgo nas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la sogs pa'i ngo bo bstan to/ /2bsam mi khyab/3gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med ces pa de 'di'o//ji ltar na/ nam mkha' rnam par rtog las grol/ /'di ni gnyis su med par brjod/ /ce'o/ de nyid la zung 'jug ces kyang bshad de/ rim lnga las/ de ltar gang gnas rnal 'byor pa/ /zung 'jug rim la gnas pa ste/

/de nyid gnyis med ye shes te/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das par brjod/ /ce'o// 'di ni gnyis su zhen pa/ med par brjod/ / de nyid dus 'di yin par bstan/ 'di ni don dam pa'i/ byang chub 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ thog ma tha ma med zhi ba// dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid gtso/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba yin// sems 'o na byang se mas sam gnyis med ye shes bsgom dgos na/ ro mnyam par rtogs pas mchog nyid/ / mi phyed pas rdo rje rdo rje rtse mo las/ ye shes rdo rje las byung ba/ /de ni rdo rje sems dpar brjod/ / rdo rje sems thams cad ro gcig par rtogs pas/ dpa' dpal/ / mchog dang po zhes so/ rdzogs pa'i sangs de bzhin nyid bden shin tu brtan/ /de kho na nyid gang rtogs nas// chos kun rtogs pa zhes byar bshad//de nyid rtogs pas sangs rgyas brjod/ / rgyas sems dpa' med cing bsgom pa med/ /'di ni byang chub rim bstan pa'o// byang chub mthar thug gi mngon par byang chub pa yin pas| nyid/ /'di ni snying po don gyi/ mi rtog pa yin pas shes bden pa de bzhin nyid shes pa//shes pas shes rab ces su brjod// rab pha rol phyin/ /pha rol phyin pa de nyid la ma chags/ nyes byas phra mos ma gos pa/ zhe sdang med pa rnam par mi 'tshe/ de la mi skrag de nyid rgyun du nyams su len pa la sems spros bral las gzhan du ma yengs pa'o/ / kun sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab ste/ gyi dngos | | mnyam pa/ nyid tu/ bsam par/ bya ba/ nyid du gsungs/ / sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo/ mchog du gyur pa/ bsgom pa nyid/ / yin phyir bsgom par 'thad/ bsam mi khyab de nyid 'gro ba brtan dang g.yo ba'i de nyid las bdag/ de'i don bsgoms na dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir sgoms shigargyu gzhan mi dmigs so/

byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas pa'i dngos grub/ dang*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos la/ sogs/ / pa'i dngos grub thams cad/ de nyid las ni thams cad skyes ba/ bsgom dgos la/ de tshul ji ltar bsgom na/ dngos po/ dang dngos po/ med par zhen pa'i/ sbyor ba dang*| bral ba/ / 'i tshul gyis/ rnal 'byor pas ni de nyid bsgom/ /dngos po/ dang dngos po/ med par zhen pa las/ rnam par/ grol ba/ / de/ bsam mi khyab de nyid bsgom na myur du 'grub par 'gyur// gang zag gang zhe na/'dod chags la sogs pa 'khor ba'i skyon ma lus skyon la sdang ba dang*//kun nas nyon mongs pa la/ rgyab kyis/ phyogs par/ nges//dpal ldan bde gshegs stobs sogs/ yon tan rnams//mtha' yas bsam mi khyab/ de las skye bar 'gyur/ / ba'i phyir bsgom par 'thad/ bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes de nyid ma rtogs pas kun bsam du med pa'i don de nyid rang bzhin gyis rtog pa dang bral yang glo bur du rnam par rtog pas gos pas 'khor ba yin la/ de nyid glo bur gyi rtog pa dang bral na mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /

rtog mang po'i mun pas de kho na nyid la sgrib pa'i ma rig pa/globur du/ khyab gyur pa'i/ / bcos ma ma yin pa de gsal du mi ster rab tu 'joms pas smyo zhing glog ltar| 'gyu ba/ / phyin ci log sna tshogs su snang*/ nyon mongs pa'i nyon mongs pa chags de la brten nas las du ma gsog pa sogs pa glo bur ba gnyen pos| dgag dka glau bur ba/ 'i dri mas gos gyur pa'i/ / de nyid la sems ni rdo rje can gyis sdug bsngal khor mor/ 'khor bar gsungs/ / sems rig pa de nyid rtogs na rang bzhin gyis/ 'od gsal ba de/ /glo bur du'ang rtog pa/ las rnam par grol/ / glor bur gyi 'dod chags 'dod chags la sogs dri mas gos pa dang de nyid kyi ngang du thim nas/ bral ba'i | | gzung ba dang ni 'dzin med sems dpa' mahā mu dra/ mchog / glo bur ba dang bral ba'i sems de nyid 'od gsal de nyid mya ngan 'das pa mchog tu gsungs/ / pa'i phyir bsgom par 'thad/ /sems nyid 'od gsal de ma rtogs de glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs pa las sdug bsngal phung po du ma'i spang ba dang ye shes thob pa'i thabs ci dgos snyam na/ mtshan gyur pa// sems 'di las gzhan du cung zad yod ma yin/ / zag pa med pa'i bde ba mtha' yas 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ / yang de yin/ sems 'od gsal ba de rtogs nas glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral na de sems/ las bsam mi khyab/ gzhan du rtogs pa las/ 'gro ba 'i rgyu yang*/ yod ma yin || de bas na sdug bsngal ma lus zad par 'dod pa dang*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes/ mtshan dpe sogs/ bde mchog thob 'dod pas/ / dmigs pa med pa'i don la sems ni rkyen gyis mi bskyod par/ brtan par 'di kun la sbyar/ byas nas 'bad pas dpyad | | dngos po sna tshogs su snang ba de bsgom/ yi rang bzhin snang ba'i dus nyid na stong par/ dngos po med par bya/ /ji srid rtog pa'i mun pa yol sdug pos/ /skye rgu'i yid bsgribs
