pa de las/ de srid sdug mtha' yas/ / pa de/ ji srid dmigs pa med pa de'i dbang gis/ de nas sems/ de ni kun rtog mun pa/ bral ba/ yin pas/ /de srid sangs rgyas dang*/ bde ba rgya chen tha dad min/ / dngos po thams cad ro mnyam pa sangs rgyas/ kun gyi mthar thug pa de la/ 'phags pa la/ dges pa'i/ / sgrib pa de yi zad phyir rang gi bya ba yang*/ / dmigs pa med pa'i/ thams cad la khyab pa rgyas pa de yis yang dag 'gro ba la khyab par/ blta/ / ji srid rtog pa'i ling thog mthug pos skye bo 'di//g.yogs pa'i mun nag de srid sdug bsngal tha mar 'gyur//nam zhig de ni spangs par gyur pa'i tshe/ /'phags pa dges pa'i dge ba rgya chen mtshungs med 'gyur/ /de zad byas na rang nyid kyis/ /shin tu rgyas shing gsal mthong 'gyur/ /ji srid ma rig rtog pa'i gos/ /skye ldan rnams kyi yid dkris pa/ /de srid sdug bsngal las byed de byed pas/ /bde ba mnyam med de phyir 'phags pa'i dges pa rab du 'bad par bya//de ru byas phyir ring ring rnam par byang ba'i tshogs der mthong*/ /zer/ don bsdu ba'i tshul gyis bsam mi khyab kho nas 'grub kyi/ gzhan gyis mi 'grub par bstan de ltar de kho na nyid kyi gnyis med kyi/ rnal 'byor pas rnal 'byor gyi dmigs med la dus thams cad du rtse gcig tu/ nges pa byas nas dang por/ dmigs med kyi don sgoms shig ces dbang rnams thob pas bka'i gnang ba thob pa/ dang*/ rang gi bza' bsrung gi dam tshig la gnas pas zhes sgyu ma ltar/ mnyam gzhag dmigs med sgom par byed na/ bsam mi khyab bsgom pa yal bar bor te lag pa'i zhags pa lcags kyu la sogs pa'i/ phyag rgya dang*/ snga gas ā hūm̐ sogs dang*/ bskyed rim sku gzugs kyi nga rgyal bsgom pa dang*/ dam tshig thun mong gi dngos grub bskyed par byed pa yin no de thams cad rang gi sems nyid du shes pas logs na med zhes bya bas ci zhig bya/

bar zhes sbyar| lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas dmigs pa med pa nyid/ kyis gdams ngag gi byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshon pa ngo shes par/ dngos su sngon du dmigs med de'i don bsgom pa/ rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor gyis zer dang bya ye shes ngos bzung ba/ bya ste/ gzugs la/ bskyed pa dang*/ goms par byas pas des mtshon pa na gnas khams/ gsum po spang blang med pa nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur ro/ / mtshan ma'i rnam pa ston pa'i gzhung thams cad spangs nas ye shes ngos bzung ba| thob pa'i gnas kyi bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor dmigs med/ de la rgyun mi 'chad du bsgom pa la/ brtson pas/ / de ltar rang byin rlabs dmigs med 'ba' zhig bsgom pas mi chog ste/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs la brten nas byung ba'i lhan skyes bsgom dgos par bstan rang sems nyid mtha' bzhi dang bral bar byin gyis rlabs pa'i rim pas bsam mi khyab 'grub par ma zad dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs kyi/ rig pa tsam la spro bas de las gzhan logs na gang yang med par rtogs pa/ nyin mtshan du goms par bya'o/ / rnam par snang mdzad kyi gnas su grags pa/ ri'i rtse mo dang*/ zhi ba'i gnas dang*/ pad+ma'i tshal dang*/ rgyal po'i bskyed mos/ tshal dang*/ kun la sbyar| skye bos dben pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas dang*/ yon tan dang ldan pas rang gi khyim mam rang gi yid dang mthun pa'i gnas/ sems la mngon par 'dod pa thams cad mkhyen pas bsngags pa 'i gnas/ 'di'i nang du gang dang gang gi gnas der gnas shing*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i thabs/ snga gas shes pa spro ba dang ldan pas bsam mi khyab kyi don/ de bsgom par byed de/ sgrub pa po thabs dang phyag rgya/ shes rab dang snyoms par 'jug pa mgyogs byed pho nya'i lam yin pas/ ma gtogs par sangs rgyas nyid mngon du thob par mi 'gyur nyes dmigs/ ro/ /de'i phyir mtshon nus pa dang grub nye bas/ shes rab ma dngos su yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub

de las don ster bas/ sbyin par byed pa lhan skyes skye ba'i rten du gyur pa/ bzang mo 'dzag pa gnyis kyi/ spang bar mi bya ste/ zhes pa lhan skyes pa'i rtogs pa bskyed pa dang*/ phyag las dang po pas bsten pa yin snyam na/ zer/ rgya re re dang ldan pa 'di ma gtogs par 'di la rten phyag rgya dang po/ tha ma/ bar du bsten dus gsum/ dngos grub myur du lhan skyes la brten nas/ ster bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir rgyud la lhan skyes kyi/ ye shes skyed pa yi/ /phyag rgya bzhi ni bsten par/ sbyar bar bya/ / bram ze mo la sogs pa spyan du bskyed gti sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa las/ mug dag pas/ phyag rgya bzhi las dam rnam snang gi sgrub pa po la/ tshig phyag rgya ste/ / de goms pa las me long bskyed/ zhe sdang phyag rgya g.yung mo mā ma kīr bskyed pa la sogs pa de goms pas chos dbyings ye shes skye ba sogs/ chen por brjod || gdol pa mo la sogs pa sgrol mar bskyed/ de las mnyam nyid/ bya ba nan tan phrag dog las kyi phyag rgya ste/ / gar ma gos dkar mor bskyed pa las kun rtog 'dod chags chos kyi phyag rgya bdag / rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i/ yo gis phyag rgya sna tshogs 'di/ / de'i phyir/ bskyed nas rig ma bde ba mngon du/ bza' bar bya/ /de la thabs shes rab/ gnyis ka yang 'du shes/ lha'i gzugs su mngon du bsam nas/ 1chos kyi 'du shes/ 2yang na/ 3chos kyi 'du shes rnam snang gi go 'phang thob par byas la des sprul pa rjes 'jug gi don bya snyams pa'o gsung gti mug bai ro de/ spyan dang sbyor ba las zhi ba bai ro tsa na'i dngos grub/ dang*/ khro ba mā ma kī dang sbyor ba las/ las ma rungs pa mi bskyod pa'i dngos grub| dang*/ gos dkar mo 'dod chags las chags pas 'od dpag med gyi dngos grub| las rnams byed do/ / bde ba skyed par byed pa'i mtshon par byed pa

de'i don du rab tu byed pa phyag rgya/ lnga po 'di rnams kyi rgyal ba rnams kyi dngos grub mngon du byed pa/ yin no// 'byor pa rab dang lus zung rab kyis snga dus ni/ dro dang*/ nyi ma'i mtha' phyi dro/ dang*/ nyi ma phyed dang*/ nam phyed kyi dus su yang phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bya'o/ / phyag rgya dang mgyogs byed| mnyam phyag rgya la brten pa ci ste zhe na/ par sbyor ba 'di man ngag las de la sbyar na/ gzhan du ni dngos grub/ 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ / thams cad du bsten nam zhe na bstan pa la smod pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa'i lam la bskur ba 'debs pa'i skye bo gdug pa mi mos/ pa'i nang du gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas phyag rgya mi bsten te/ rang gi sems 'ba' zhig der bsam pas sems la snying kha nas nai rāt+ma sprul te de dang snyoms 'jug byed par bsams/ lhag par mos pa mngon du bya'o/ /gang zhig yang rnal 'byor pa grogs/ brtson 'grus kyi 'bad pas phyag rgya bsten pa'i/ rnal 'byor 'di bsgrub par bya'o | | shes rab lo grangs dang mthun pa/ 1mi'i bu mo2rigs dang mthun pa mngon du ma rnyed na byol tir ti ka ste logs ma la yang 'jug pas mi'i bu mo las logs pa lha'am gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa song dag la'ang rigs dang mthun pa las la sogs pa mi mthun pa la yang*/ rtag tu goms par bya'o/ /de ltar gang zhig rnal 'byor pas gal te phyag rgya/ pad+ma 'dzin pa la mngon du nyi ma re re dam tshig bsten pa 'am/ nus pa rab 'bring ngam/ 'byor pa rab 'bring gsum gyis/ zla ba so so 'am/ lo la reg par mi byed na ltung ba bcu gsum par/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ro/ / des lhan skyed kyi rtog pa bskyed pas ma bsten na dam tshig nyams pas rnal 'byor pa bag med pa 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa/ skye bar 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i phyir 'chos pa'i/ dam tshig blangs par byas nas yang mi byed par

phyis mi nyams pas/ sdom pa gzung bar bya ste/ /de'i phyir rigs lnga po| kun gyi sdom pa dang ldan zhing de kho na nyid bsgom pa/ la gnas pas phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bya'o/ / bza' ba'i dam tshig gsang ba'i nye ba'i rdzas byang sems sgrub pa'i rim gro dang | sngags kyis byin gyis rlabs pa/ sbyor thabs gnyis kyis dus mnyam du dbab pa dang mi 'chor bar snga gas dang*/ rgyud nyid kyi 'di skad e waṃ rdor pad/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yang dag par rdor pad/ sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor gyis rtag tu nye bar 'dug ste khams gsum lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dbyer med du bsgoms pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i go 'phang*/ gnas su gnas gsum po rtse gcig pa'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya'o | | rig pa gsal ba thabs dang ngo bo spros pa dang bral ba/ shes rab kyi don bsgom pa zhes bya ba gnyis pa las rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// // 1'di ni rdo rje theg pa rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad pa'i rgyud de/ spyi'i rnam gzhag gnas/ lha bskyed chog ste gsum mo/ /gnas ni gnyis te sgrub pa po'i gnas dang*/ lha'i gnas gnyis su bsdus nas gsal bar bshad| bsgom par bya ba'i lha nyid kyang rigs lnga ru bsdus/ ci ste yang sku mdog dang*/ zhal phyag gi dbyibs dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ bzhugs tshul la sogs pa tshul du mas gnas shing*/ rigs lnga po de bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi yab yum dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang*/ rjes su 'brangs pa'i lha mo la sogs pa thams cad kyang rigs lngas bsdus shing de las logs pa med do zhes bsdus te gsal bar bshad/ lha rnams kyi bskyed chog dang*/ ji ltar bde ba zhes pas sgrub pa po'i ngo gang gi bskyed chog tha dad pa yin te/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i mngon byang lnga dang*/ mi mnyam par sbyor ba'i mngon byang lnga dang*/ rdo rje cho ga yan lag gsum dang*/ bzhi dang*/ snying po tshig tsam las bskyed pa dang*/

dbugs dbyung rngub kyi tshul gyis spro bsdu las bskyed pa ston pas dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ rdzogs par bya ba'i tshul ni las kyi lha'i bye brag gis yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas mchod bstod/ bdud rtsi myangs/ mthar bzlas pa/ rnal 'byor bsdu ba'i bar du bya'o/ /yang dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs/ dbu rgyan rang chas can du bsgom pa yang yod/ kha cig dam tshig pa bskyed/ dbu rgyan bsgom nas bzlas brjod rdzogs pas dngos grub sgrub par byed pa yang yod/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin zhes dang*| dngos grub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba kha bskang ba yin no/ /de ltar tshul gsum gyis bshad do/ /rtsad pa'i skyon spang ba zhus lan cung zad tsam ni/ don dam par chos sku la dgongs nas sgrub pa'i thabs la sogs pa gang yang grub pa med la/ gdul bya'i mos pa dang bstun nas kun rdzob tu gang yang yod par bstan/ tshul de lta bu mi gsal ba gsal bar bshad/ he ru ka gsum gyi thun mong gi cho ga ni brtag gnyis dang cha mthun|2rten dang brten pa'i de mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ las rgyas pa'i lha mo gsum nas 'khor lo thams cad kyi/ / 'di bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje dbyings kyi mdor bstan du 'gro gsung*/ skye med las skye ba'i cho 'phrul du rnam par 'phrul pa yang dag bshad/ / de gang gi rnal 'phrul yin zhe na brten pa dpal ldan rdo rje sems sogs lha'i phyag gnyis pa / / bzhi pa dang drug pa/ snod kyi 'jig rten tha mal pa thams rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs su gyur pa la bshad/ cad las ni rten gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa la sogs pa/ sna tshogs mchog / gzhal yas khang de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo tha mal pa'i yul min pas gsang ba mchog tu dges pa 'byung ba'i gzhi yin pas| pa ni/ /thams cad de ta thā thams cad kyi/ bdag nyid de lta bu de gang du sgrub ce na/ 'di la bsgrub/

/ bzhugs pa de bsgom/ 1gnas gang du zhe na 2so so skye bo'i 'du 'dzi dang rnam par bral dang gong du bstan pa'i ri'i rtse mo la sogs pa'i/ gnas su dkyil 'khor khang pa/ yang*/ / dzo ki phyi'i skye mos tshal la sogs te rgyas bshad las rigs lnga ka'i gnas rang gi tshal sogs rnams su yang*/ / der lha gang bsgom na kun phyogs bcu po/ las sna tshogs rigs lnga po de phyogs sna tshogs/ kha dog sna tshogs las/ phyag rgya so so'i yum dang bcas pa/ ste/ / bzhugs pa'i tshul te rang rang gi gnas su bkod pa'o/ / kun las sna tshogs des tha mal pa'i rtog pa/ sdom pa yi// tshul ji ltar bsgom na kun las sna tshogs bya ba rnams/ / bskyed lugs drod gsher skyed cha skyes ja la sogs pa ji ltar bde ba gang dga'/ bar bsgrub par bya/ / 'og nas 'byung ba'i rnam snang la sogs pa bde gshegs kun gyi rten dang brten pa'i/

dkyil 'khor ni/ / don dam par stong pa kun gyi ye shes nyid/ yin pas/ de la khro bo'i sgrub thabs drag po'i gdan can| thams cad dang*/ /zhi ba rigs bzhi yum bzhi/ rnams kyi lha rnams la/ / mi 'dra ci zhig nga yis bsgom pa/ bshad par bya/ / ste bshad du med kyang kun rdzob tu/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i cho 'phrul du mas/ lha du ma sangs rgyas de kho na rtogs/ gar/ / du mar sprul/ bsgom pa lha yi rnal 'byor dang*/ / sngag sa kyi bzlas pa'i chog rim dang*/ /bris sku 'am ni sku gzugs kyang*/ /thams cad sems kyi rtog pa/ kun rdzob tu sprul pa ste/ / dgos pa sems can rnams la phan 'dod phyir/ / khro bo dang zhi ba la sogs pa bsgom par nga yis rgyud du bsgrags pa yin/ / don dam par stong nyid gcig las rdo rje can/ / gyi/ kun rdzob tu rigs ni rnam pa lnga ru gsungs/ / pa de la/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ lha bskyed pa de/ yig 'bru sa bon gyi yi ge 'i gzugs dang ni/ / lha'i phyag rgya dbyibs kyi chog rim rdo rje cho ga bzhi la sogs pa/ dang*/ / grogs snga gas kyi bzlas pa'i chog rim dang | | bzlas bsgom gang gi sgrub po dngos grub/ 'grub 'gyur ba/ /gtso bo shin tu zag pa dang bcas pa'i/ dga' chen pos/ /bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol/ / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / 1lha'i le'u don gsal bar/2phyag rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis bstan te/ he ru ka gsum gyi dang*/ dpal he ru ka'i dang*/ bdag med ma'i dang*| rigs bzhi yum dang bcas pa'i dang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i dang*/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dang*/drag po'i gdan can gyi'o/ /sgrol ma la sogs pa ni las rgyas pa yin pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ / dang po byams pa bsgom par bya/ /gnyis par snying rje rnam par bsgom/ /gsum par dga' ba bsgom par bya/ /kun gyi tha mar btang snyoms so/ /yang ni stong pa'i byang chub sems/

/gnyis pa la ni sa bon am̐/ bsdu/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru dgod/ / rgyas par re phas nyi ma sngon du rnam bsgoms nas/ /nyi der hūm̐ byung sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje 'i/ de kho na/ nyid kyis ni ra hūm̐/ ba dang*/ /gur yang cho ga bzhin du bsgom par bya/ / ha/ lha bskyed pa'i dang a| por ro ni de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma/ bsgom par bya/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid brjod/ /de steng rnal 'byor pa gnas nas/ /he ru ka nyid rnam bsgom bya/ / phyag gnyis pa la sogs pa/ gsum ka'i thun mong gi cho ga rang gi snying khar re pha raṃ/ bsgom/ /de las byung ba'i nyi dkyil 'khor/ /der ni hūm̐ gi dbyibs nyid ni// ha thabs dang shes rab u dang am̐/ bdag nyid can/ / de las 'od 'phros pas kha dog nag po 'jigs chen po/ / 'bring rdo rje cho ga yan lag gsum las bskyed pa ston hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje nyid/ /rdo rje lte ba'i dbus gnas par/ /yang ni hūṃ gi de nyid bsgom/ /de nyid yongs su gyur bltas nas/ /zhe sdang bdag nyid rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje skye ba nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las/ dpa' chen po/ /rdo rje skye ba nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las dpa' chen po/ /'dam skyes sngon po 'dra ba 'am/ /yang na sngo la rtsa dmar/ sngo dang nyi ma ltar// dad pas nges par bsgom par bya/ /nam mkhar rje btsun zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa| bltas nas ni/ / rdo rje'i rgyu las skyes pas/ rdo rje skye ba snying rje che/ / chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo las/ rgyan rnams thams cad mchod pa'i yo byad/ 'dzin pa yi/ /lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par bya/ / mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad dkar mo ri dwags zla bas/ mtshan ma byang sems| 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal nyi ma/ ba'i snod/ / rak+ta/ ro langs ma ni dri| chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman dri chen/ 'dzin cing*/ /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje lag

/ sha de bzhin ri khrod ma bcud kyi len gyi/ ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u rdung*/ /g.yung mo sku la 'khyud pa ste/ /mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa yi/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod | | bdun rnam dag kha bskang*/ de nas gnas tha mal pa'i rtog pa/ las rnam grol ba'i// chos rnams kun gyi bdag thams cad la khyab pa'i stong pa/ nyid 'gyur/ /ā li las/ zla ba kā li las/ nyi/ / 1ma 2rgyas pa mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa ston/ sa bon nang du son rig pa | | de nyid sems dpa' 'i rgyu yin pas/ zhes byar brjod/ / hūm̐ de nyid gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi yid tsam gyi ngo bo mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin can/ / de'i snying kha nas lha mo brgyad spro| nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyab pa yis/ / 'khor bskyed/ rang rang*/ gi lus dang*/ mtshungs rnam par spro/ / sa nas sems can gyi don byed/ / bsdus nas ro gdan brgyad kyi/ snying khar dgug pa na/ /yo gi 'khor dang bcas pa/ zhe sdang bdag nyid 'gyur/ / ha nam mkha'i khams kyi bsrung 'khor gyi/ nang son pa/ /de nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor a| bsam/ / bsdus pa snying po tshig tsam las bskyed pa hūm̐ skyes sngo dang nyi ma ltar/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /spyan gsum skra ni gyen du ser/ / bdud la sogs pa skrag par byed pas sdang mig brgyad gnyis lo yi dbyibs/ / stan ro yin kyang 'jigs byed skrag par byed pa la bya 'jigs byed dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa skrag par byed/ mnan cing g.yon pa 'i mchan khung*/ na/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nyid dang*/ /thod pa yang ni g.yon pa na/ /g.yas na rdo rje nag po nyid/ /hūm̐ ni 'don par byed pa'i bdag /lha mo brgyad kyis bskor nas ni/ /dur dur khrod kyi bshad pa 'dir gsung*/ khrod du ni lus/ mgon po rol/ / spros pa la dga' bas ye shes la gzhug pa| sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa/

dbang bskur ba kha las shes de ltar rnal 'byor pas bsgom bya/ / zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bsgom pa rnal 'byor bdud rtsi tha mal pa'i rtog pa/ sdom pa kun/ / thal mal pa'i rtog pa'i 'ching ba dang bral ba/ de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ / gang gi rnal 'byor zhe na rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ / cho ga gsum ka'i mngon byang 'gre'o|gsung rdo rje phyag bzhi pa bsgom pa ston pa khro bo'i gzugs ni 'dzin gyur pa/ /phyag bzhi yis rgyud phyi ma las zhal yang bzhir yod/ ni rnam par spras/ /bdud bzhir zhen pa/ rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ / nang du dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin no/ / srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang na snga ra gsungs dkyil 'khor 'khor lor gnas/ / rdo rje cho ga yan lag gsum gyis bskyed pa ste/ raṃ las nyi/ hūm̐ las rdo rje/ de las phyag bzhi pa/ yang na mngon par byang chub pa lnga las/ 'dis 'og ma la 'gre hūm̐ gi sa bon las byung ba'i/ /g.yon na thod pa lha ra gang zhen pa/ dang ni//lha min de shar zhen pa/ khrag gis gang ba dang*/ /g.yas na rdo rje me lta bus/ / 'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /gzhan pa yi ni phyag dag gis/ / yum gyi| lus la yang dag 'khyud pa nyid/ /shes rab rdo rje phag mo ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs can khro mo'i cha lugs dang nag po/ bsgom/ / 'di man chad phyag drug par mdzad dang shū n+ya tā'i/ po stong pa bsgom bya zhing*/ / paṃ las pad+ma/raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de las sna tshogs rdo rje/lte bar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros pas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gnyis pa la ni cha bral kā li/ nyid/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ / gdan der hūm̐ las rdo rje de las byung bar/ ni hūm̐ ni bsgom par bya/ / khyad par du srung 'khor gyi dbus su bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo las gzhal yas khang*/ gtso bo mngon byang lnga las bskyed/ 'khor mngal nas bskyed de bzhin bskyed chog gong ma ltos/

zhal gsum phyag drug par/ / rtsa ba'i rgyud nas ma tshang na kha skong ba'i tshul lha yi gzugs su bsgom par bya/ / rtsa/ dang po'i zhal ni dkar min nag po/ zhing*/ / g.yas pa dkar zhing zhi ba nyid/ /g.yon pa dmar po lta bu ste/ /spyan gsum bzang po'i 'dug stangs/ gzugs can nyid/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis yang dag gang | | thod pa'i dang zla ba/ stan la yang dag gnas/ / g.yon gyi gsum pa na bshang gci khu ba khrag sha'ang mtshon te lnga/ rnams kyis/ / 1bkang ba'i/ 2 rtsa ba'i rgyud na g.yas rdo rje dang gri gugagayon rtse gsum dang dril bu/ thod pa phyag gis bzung ba dang*/ / g.yas 'og ma dang g.yon 'og ma go rim bzhin gzhu g.yon gyi gnyis pa na/ dang g.yas kyi gnyis pa na/ mda' ni 'dzin pa nyid/ /de bzhin g.yas kyi dang po na/ rdo rje g.yon gyi dang po na dril bu nyid/ / g.yas dang por rdo rje 'bar ba dang*/ / g.yas kyi gsum par de bzhin rtse gsum pa// dang po gnyis kyis dpal ldan shes rab lu gu rgyud ma la/ 'khyud pa dang*/ /ral pa'i cod pan brgyan pa ste/ /sprin gyi 'od lta bu/ 'bar du ma ni/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig spro bar bya/ /bha ga'i chos 'byung gi dbus su 'di nyid la thod pa bya ste bde ba skyong ba'o// sgrub pa pos | | der ni bdag nyid phyag drug par/ bsgom par bya/ /lha mo lu gu rgyud ma dang*/ lhan cig ldan par ni/ /de nas phyag rgya bsgom par bya/ / 'di gtso bo mngon byang ngam cho ga gsum gang las bskyed kyang 'khor mngal skyes so/ /yang na gtso bo mngon byang ngam cho ga gsum las/ lha mo'ang snyoms 'jug gi sgras bskul te sa bon las sam/ yang na snying kha las so/ / thod 'khor gyi lha mo 'dab brgyad la thod pa brgyad/ pa'i stan la gnas par ni/ / chos 'byung bsgom pa la bya/ der zla ba bsgom/ 'dab mar lha mo bri bsam/ bar bya/ / mngal skyed kyi tshul du phyung nas/ kha dog sna tshogs gzugs ma yid 'ong ma/ /zhal gcig ma la phyag bzhi ma/

/dang 'phar ma gnyis pa'i nang gi 'phar ma'i shar du/ po rig ma rdo rje drag mo dkar mo/ bri bar bya/ / g.yon dang po gzhu dang g.yas dang po/ mda' ni 'dzin ma mdzes/ / g.yon gnyis pa thod pa khu bas gang ba dang*/ / g.yas gnyis pa lcags kyu lag pas 'dzin ma'o/ / 1lhor 2g.yas gnyis par mdung rtse lag pa dang*/ / rdo rje gzugs brnyan ma ser mo/ g.yon dang po khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ / g.yas dang po rdo rje de bzhin g.yon gnyis pa zhags pa nyid | | nub tu gsum 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ pa'i lag par g.yas dang po/ ral gri dang | | g.yon dang po thod pa dri/ chu yis zhag gis/ gang ba dang*/ /de bzhin g.yas gnyis pa| rdo rje g.yon gnyis pa/ dril bu nyid/ / byang du rdo rje zhi ba ma ljang khu bzhi pa g.yas gnyis pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lag ma/ /g.yon pa'i lag pa gnyis/ pas thod pa nyid/ / g.yas dang po mu rnga'i bye brag sun+ṭi ral gri yod/ dang ba dan rtse/ gsum/ / g.yon dang po/ byang shar du rdo rje gnod sbyin ma dkar ser lnga pa g.yas dang po/ dbyig 'di rdo rje yin gsung pa'i lag pa dang*/ / g.yon dang po/ thod pa lag pas bzung ba dang*/ / g.yas gnyis pa de bzhin ut+pal g.yon gnyis pa/ cang te'u nyid/ / shar lhor rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser drug pa'i lag pas g.yas dang po/ pad+ma dang*/ / g.yon dang po thod pa chang gis gang ba dang*/ /de bzhin g.yas gnyis pas/ me long g.yon gnyis pas/ dgra s+t+wa nyid/ / lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma sngo dmar bdun pa g.yas dang pos/ 'phang mdung lag pa dang*/ / gnyis pa dung dang g.yon dang po| 'khor lo'i mtshon cha 'dzin/ / gnyis pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba ni/ / gdan gyi steng khru gang tsam du yang dag bsam par bya/ bri/ / nub byang du sa rdo rje ma ljang skya brgyad pa g.yas dang pos/ bum pa'i lag pa dang*/ /de bzhin g.yas gnyis pa/ rdo rje g.yon gnyis pa| dril bu nyid/ / g.yon dang po thod pa skyes pa'i pags pa yis/

/bkab pa lnga/ rdzas kyis bkang ba 'dzin/ ni/ /ze 'brur he ru ka phyag drug pa/ bde ba chen po dang*/ / gsang gnas nas phyung ste 'dab mar lha mo brgyad po yid kyis/ bri bar bya/ /rol mo rnam pa sna tshogs rnams/ / mi gsal ba gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ / phyi'i 'phar ma'i sgo bzhir sgo ba bzhi zhal gsum phyag drug bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ lha mo rdo rje lcags kyu ma sngo sangs zhal gsum rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum/ lcags kyu/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum/ zhags pa/ sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dang*/ /rdo rje zhags pa ma dkar ser/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ g.yas zhags pa/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon 'khor lo/ dril bu/ sdigs mdzub/ lcags sgrog ma dmar mo g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ g.yas lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri g.yon 'khor lo/ dril bu/ lcags kyu'o/ / dang*/ /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu ma zhal gsum ljang khu/ nag po/ dmar po/ g.yas rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ ral gri/ g.yon dril bu/ 'khor lo/ zhags pa/ nyid/ /sgo yi skyong ba yang dag bri/ /bha ga'i dbus su chos 'byung nang du/ bsgom bya zhing*/ /phyis ni bzlas pa yang dag brtsams/ /hūm̐ ni thugs kyi/ rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ / mgo 'dren| oṃ sku'i/ ni dbyangs kyi 'byed pa nyid/ / gsung āḥni ngag dang yang dag ldan/ / shel gyi dag pa dkar po/ lta bu nyid/ /hrīḥni de la yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin du yang swā hā nyid/ / snga gas kyi bzlas pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā/ yang dag gsungs/ / yid kyis bris kyi dngos su bkod mi dgos pas bsam gtan yi ge gcig pu yin/ /lha mo brgyad po/ rnams kyi sa bon/ hrīḥnyid ni/ /'dab ma brgyad po/ rnams la de nas dgod/ / me tog ma sogs mchod pa mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi'i sa bon/ bzhi yi rang bzhin las/ / bsdus dkyil nas phyag gnyis pa/ sa bon ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄/ bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /sgo yi skyong ba thams cad

kyi sa bon| du/ /dang po'i dbyangs yig a ā la aṃ aḥ sogs ldan/ / lu gu rgyud ma'i bha ga nyid du sgrub pa pos//de nas rdo rje gzhug par bya/ /hrīḥyi rnam pa nyid dang yang*/ / pad+ma hrīḥs byin gyis rlabs pa/ de la sbyor ba byed tsam na/ hūm̐ ni brjod par bya/ /zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i| dus su khrag 'dres/ bcas pa'i/ khu ba lces blangs/ kha yis bza' bar bya/ / bdag nyid rigs bdag gi kha/ dang ni bha ga mdzes spyi/ la/ /me tog sih+la/ dri shu kra yis mchod par kha snar mngon du bya/ /gal te sgrub po dngos grub/ grub 'dod na/ /de nyid la ni sngon du/ bzlas par bya/ / gong gi dang por rig ma zhes pa la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad po'i ming mi gsal bar bstan rdo rje drag mo de bzhin gcig /de bzhin rdo rje gzugs brnyan gnyis

| | gsum pa 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /bzhi pa rdo rje zhi ba ma/ /lnga pa rdo rje gnod sbyin ma/ /drug pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /bdun pa sgra yi rdo rje ma/ /de bzhin brgyad pa rdo rje sa/ /gnyis pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// // 1sbyor gdan gyi rab byed gnyis pa dang cha mthun/ kha bskang*/ gur gyi le'u brgyad pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma cha mthun/ tsakra kha skong*/ gnyis po'ang kha/ he'i bcu gcig kyang 'dra'o/ /2rdo rje gdan bzhi'i sbyor ba'i gdan gyi rab tu byed pa gnyis pa dang cha mthun pa ston 'khor lo'i sgrub par bya ba'i las bsgrub/ pa'i khyad par gyi/ / las rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa/ rim pa ji lta ba/ bzhin bshad kyis/ rdo rje nyon/ / bsgrub par bya ba'i khyad par de nyid bstan pa zhi dang rgyas pa dbang rnams dang*/ /srung dang de bzhin mngon spyod nyid/ / 1tsakra rtsibs brgyad lte ba dang dgu 2las de sgrub pa'i tsakra bstan 3mu khyud rung gsung 4'khor lo 'di rnams la gzhi/ snag tsha thabs/ tshul ji ltar bsgrub pa'o/ /de ni bsrung gdags gsum las gdags pa'i pu tsa rgyun mi 'chad par bzhagamangon spyod me thabs sogs su mnan re'u mig dgu sogs 'khor lo yi/ /phyi rol mu khyud ri mo gnyis kyis zlum por/ nyid du bya/ /'khor lo'i las kyi kha dog bye brag gi kha dog gi bye brag tu dbye/ sogs/ / la/ tsakra bri ba bstan mkhas pas rnam par bsgom par bya/ /oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ /'di yi sa bon thams cad 'khor lo'i re'u mig rnams la dgod par bya'o// kyi/ / oṃ phyag 'tshal sreg blugs hā/ tha ma ni/ / dbus kyi lte ba la oṃ dang hā/kha sbyor gyi dbus oṃ dang hā'i/ su ming ni gang bsrung ba'i ming dang gnyis ka bri/ sbyar bar bya/ / zhi ba dang dbang du bya ba'i bye brag gi shin+taṃ dang puṣ+tiṃ la sogs pa spel srung ba'i (bsrung bya ) srungs shig bcas pa'i tshig kyang rnam par bya/

/ 1rab gnas dus 2tsakra ji ltar bsgom zhe na mnyam nyid ye shes sarba/ stong pas ni/ / tsakra bdag nyid lus ni bkru bar bya zer/ kyi ni gzugs su bya/ / thams cad stong pa mnyam nyid thams cad rig pa yi zer/ kun rig ting nge 'dzin la/ gnas nas| su ni/ / stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i srung 'khor bskyed/ 'khor lo sbyar bar bya/ / ste de la bstims la mchod/ srung ba 'i tsakra ye shes can gyis bsgom/ / pa na/ bgegs la sogs pa 'jigs pa thams cad ring du byed/ / tshogs gnyis sngon du song nas sems can bsrung ba stong par/ dngos po med par bsams la/ na ni/ / stong pa'i ngang las sgrol mar rnal 'byor dngos po bsgom par bya/ / tāṃ las ut+pal tāṃ gis mtshan pa las spros bsdus te gcig tu gyur pa las tā ra bskyed zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ / zla ba'i 'og tu pad+ma'i gdan ni bsam par bya/ / dman pa'i dngos grub thams cad rab ster mar/ /bdag gi lus yan lag drug byin gyis brlabs pa/ ni bsgom par bya/ /oṃ tā re swāhā/ mgo bo la'o | | oṃ tu re swāhā/ mig dag la'o/ /oṃ tā re swāhā/ sna dag la'o/ /oṃ tū swāhā/rna ba dag la'o/ /oṃ re swāhā/ lce la'o/ /oṃ tā ri ni swāhā/ snying khar ro// yan lag drug ni rtag tu gzung*/ /'phags ma sgrol ma bsam par bya/ / da ni phyag la sogs pa'i nges pa bstan phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung*/ / se mo do la sogs pa rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ / phyag g.yas kun la mi 'jigs lag pa dang | | g.yon na ut+pal lta bu mchog / de lta bu bskyed nas snga gas spros pa la dga' na yan lag bzhi ka thams cad la sbyar kyi dbu rgyan la don grub bsgoms nas sngags bkodanas/ rgyal pos bskul ba yi/ / dbang du bya ba la sogs pa'i lha rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya/ / rtsa ba'i rgyud cha mthun/ mi gsal ba gsal/ ma tshang ba kha skong du 'gro oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/

/las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ / 'khor lo bstan dgra dang rgyal pos btson rar/ bcings pa dang*/ / sbrul gyi 'gro ba shin tu 'jigs pa'i dug / dug zhi ba la kha dog dkar mo/ ut+pal lcags kyu'i dod bdud rtsi bum pa dang*/ klu brgyad rgyan can no// yan lag la/ rims ni sna tshogs 'byung ba/ dang*/ / gnas pa'i dug sogs dus min 'chi ba ni/ /'jigs pa'i gnas ni gang gang la/ / 'khor lo*/ de dang de la rab sbyar bya/ /shes rab chung ba blo ldan pa | ra bya ba'i phyir/ /srung ba 'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug mu khyud dang bcas pa/ rtsibs drug la yi ge drug lte ba la maṃ che ge mo rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pa bri/ bris nas gzung bar bya/ /srung ba bzang po 'di nyid ni | | 'jigs pa thams cad ring du ni spangs/ /bsrung ba 'di ni las/ thams cad bsrung thabs/ las/ / bsrung ba'i rnal 'byor de nyid gong na med/ / lha bsgom pa bstan te tshogs gnyis sngon du 'gro 'bar ba'i 'od zer lta bu yi/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsams nas ni/ /de yi dbus su hrīḥnyid ni/ dug sogs dkar po kha dog dmar po lta bu'i 'od/ / de las ut+pal la hrīḥs mtshan pa de las spros bsdus gcig tu gyur pa las/ de nas bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ / rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu gcig pa nas zhal gcig ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /mda' dang gzhu yi lag pa ma/ /ut+pal la dang lcags kyu 'dzin/ / dbu rgyan rin 'byung gsung*/ 'di ni bsgoms pa dang bzlas pa/ tsam gyis ni/ / las sbyor gyi dus su 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed/ /'bum phrag gcig gis rgyal po rnams/ khri yis 'jig rten phal pa nyid/ /bye bas phyugs dang gnod sbyin sogs/ /'bum phrag bdun gyis lha ma yin/ /'bum phrag gnyis kyis lha rnams nyid/ /brgya phrag gcig gis sngags pa nyid/ / shes rab 'phel ba'i 'khor lo bstan/ gur le'u bzhi par tshul mi mthun pas bshad pa'i rgyud 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa 'di/

kha dog dkar po shin tu mdzes | | pa bris la 'dab brgyad la yig brgyad dbus su oṃ dang hā'i bar du gang blo 'phel bar bya rgyu'i ming bcug la bri'o/ tsakra stong par mnyam gang blo 'phel rgyu de stong par bsam/ nyid gzugs su bsams nas ni/ khams gsum gyi ni rang bzhin las/ / yang stong par bsam/ shū n+ya tās stong par byas la de'i ngang las tsakra snga ra gyi mtshan nyid yang dag ldan/ / sgrol ma la sogs pa'i bskyed lugs bzhin gong du gsungs pas rab gnas/ bsgrub par bya/ /shes rab nyer 'bar las rnams ni/ /'di yi 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ / gur du pi tsu pi tsu pradzñās cha swāhā/ ja sngags byas pa yin oṃ pradzñā+e shes rab/ mahā chen mo/ pradzñā+e shes rab/ hūm̐ swāhā/ / rang nyid dngos tshogs bsags sngon du song nas tsakra rak+ṣa'i nang du paṃ pad raṃ nyi las/ po'i ngo bos pradzñā pa ra mi tar/ bsgom par bya/ /'od zer 'bar ba du ma yi/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i/ bdag nyid du rang*/ rnam par sprul/ /phyag gnyis g.yas phar phyin gyi po ti bsnams pa/ g.yon pad+ma dmar po/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung*/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ kha dog dkar mo 'od gsal ma/ /shes rab bdag nyid gzung bar bya/ / spros pa la dga' na ye shes pa gzhug pa sogs bya/ dbu rgyan a mi/ 'di yi sa bon yi ge bzlas na ni/ /shes rab pad+ma'i| 'dab ma lta bur gong du/ 'phel/ /gu ba 'am blo ni dman pa yi/ /shes rab 'phel ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ / 1rigs bzhi yum bzhi la me tog phog pas rig 'dzin bsgrub pa'i dbang du byas te/ 'dus pa'i bdun pa dang bcu gcig pa sogs su gsungs kyang phyag bzhi pa kha bskang*/ rnam snang sgyu drwa'i rtog pa bzhi pa/ ḍā ka dang po/ 2a las zla rnam snang gi dkyil 'khor/ ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ / bh+ruṃ aṃ yi ge de la dgod par phyag mtshan 'di bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du'ang 'dra'o//tshogs gnyis sngon du song nas srung 'khor nang du chos 'byung du thod zla/des kun la 'gre'o//

bya/ / ste snying po tshig tsam gyis bskyed pa'am/ yang na sa bon las phyag mtshan lte bar sa bon gyis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros gcig tu gyur pa las bskyed/ des 'og ma la'ang 'gre'o/ gdan thod pa'i stan gyi dbus su zla ba de la/ gnas par/ / bh+rūṃ las spros bsdus gcig tu gyur pa las zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /zhi ba dkar po g.yas dang po/ 'khor lo g.yon dang po| dril bu 'dzin/ / g.yas gnyis pa thod pa dang ni g.yon gnyis pa/ zhags pa nyid/ /de bzhin 'od/ 'bar ba'i phreng 'khrug par/ /kun tu rnam par spro bar bya/ / gong gi 'dis ni rnal 'byor 'di'i/ rim pas ni/ / a las zla ba'i steng du aṃ ngaṃ hrīḥlas rin chen 'byung gnas bsgom par bya/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog lta bur/ /sku mdog ser po nga rgyal rnam par dag pa yin pas/ gzi brjid che/ /thod pa dang zla ba/ 'i stan gyi dbus gnas par/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /dpa' bo g.yas gnyis/ rin chen lcags kyu 'dzin/ / g.yon gnyis thod pa de bzhin zhags pa nyid/ / 'gre 'dis ni rnal 'byor rim pas ni/ / dz+riṃ ngaṃ hrīḥ las pad+ma rdo rje 'chang ba gdan thod pa dang zla ba la| bsgom/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /pad+ma rā ga lta bu'i 'od/ /dpa' bo g.yas dang po/ mda' dang g.yon dang po/ gzhu 'dzin cing*/ /thod pa'i stan la yang dag bzhugs | | 'og ma gnyis pad+ma zhags pa 'dzin pa nyid/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /'dis ni rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ / khaṃ las don yod phyag gi ral dper na dpa' bo ral gri ma shor ba dgra'i ske gcod pa bzhin 'di yang chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin sems can gyi don byed/ gri ni/ /thod pa'i stan gyi dbus bzhugs par/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ / g.yon gnyis thod pa rdo rje sa mtshan pa'i/ dril bu dang*/ / g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dag ni g.yas pas 'phyar/ / sna tshogs kyi ngo bos bai ḍūr+ya ltar ljang khu ste// rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/

/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang chos 'byung gi nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus son par/ / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /de la nang son sa bon ni/ /bh+ruṃ las spyan gyi dbyibs su ni/ /thod pa'i stan gyi dbus gnas par/ /phyag ni brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ / g.yas bzhi rim pa bzhin 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi thod pa/ dril bu/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ 'khor lo'i lag pa mda' dang gzhu//de bzhin rdo rje dril bu nyid//zhags pa ral gri thod pa nyid// spyan gsum ma la zhal gcig ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis yang dag brgyan/ gang*/ / do shal dang ni rkang gdub brgyan/ kha dog dkar mo shin tu mdzes/ /de bzhin thod pa'i dbu rgyan nyid/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus son par/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya/ yongs gang ba/ /de la nang son bsam par bya/ /hūm̐ las mā ma kī yi dbyibs/ /thod pa'i stan gyi dbus gnas par/ kha dog sngon mo 'bar chen mo//spyan gsum ma la zhal gcig ma/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan// g.yas drug gi dang po mda' dang g.yon drug gi dang po/ gzhu ni 'dzin pa nyid/ / g.yon gnyis lcags kyu dang g.yas gnyis/ ni ral gri dang*/ / g.yon gsum zhags pa g.yas gsum/ rdo rje de bzhin du/ / g.yon bzhi dril bu dang ni g.yon lnga/ thod pa'o/ / g.yas bzhi 'khor lo g.yas lnga rin chen g.yas drug pad+ma dang*/ / g.yon drug pa khaṭ+wāṃ ga nyid bcu gnyis ni/ / gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yid kyis/ bri bar bya/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan | | chos 'byung bha ga'i dbus su yongs gang ba'i/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /der ni hrīḥni bsam bya zhing*/ /gos dkar zhes bya rnam bsgom bya | | thod pa'i stan gyi dbus gnas par/ kha dog dmar mo 'bar chen ma/ / rgyan rnams kun gyis yongs gang ma/ /phyag brgyad kyis ni rnam par brgyan/ / g.yon bzhi na gzhu dang g.yas bzhi na/ mda' ni 'dzin pa dang*/ / g.yon pad+ma'i lag pa

g.yas| ral gri rdo rje'o// dang*/ / g.yon thod pa g.yas rdo rje sa mtshan pa'i/ dril bu dang*/ / g.yon zhags pa de bzhin g.yas rin chen nyid/ /do shal dang ni rkang gdub sgra/ / rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'di bsgom na/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i dbus su yongs gang ba'i/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de la nang son tāṃ nyid ni/ /sgrol ma'i dbyibs su bsam par bya/ /thod pa'i stan gyi dbus gnas par/ /phyag brgyad kyis ni rnam par brgyan/ / g.yas bzhi na/ ral gri phyag ma chags bcas ma/ /ut+pal de bzhin lcags kyu dang*/ / mda'o/ g.yon pa bzhi na 'khor lo dang*/ zhags pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang*/ gzhu'o/ /zhags pa de bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ /gzhu dang g.yas tha ma| mda' ni 'dzin pa nyid/ /zhal gcig pa ni yang dag bri/ kha dog ljang khu spyan gsum ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /de ltar rnal 'byor pas bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam par 'gyur/ / 'di dag gi bzlas pa bdun pa'i gnyis par 'byung ba yin/ rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi gsang ba dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba las brtag pa'i rgyal po gnyis pa'o// //༈ phyag bcu drug pa rtsa ba'i rgyud du ma tshang ba kha skong ba'i tshul du bshad/ he ru ka phyag bcu drug pa| dang bdag med ma'i/ /skyed pa'i sgo nas/ bsgrub bya/ dang phyag rgya chen po/ de nyid nyon// he ru ka gang bdag med ma/ gis gdug pa chags pa can/ drag po zhe sdang can/ kun/ /sems can kun/ 'dul bar gang gyur pa'i/ / he ru ka mkha' 'gro sa mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma nai rāta| mdzad pa'i/ /de dag thams cad khyod la bshad/ / tshogs bsags nas khang pa'i bar kha bskang gsung rdo mngon byang lnga las rgyu'i/ rje sems dpar gyur nas kyang*/ /rdo rje ye shes 'khor lo/ can nyid rdo rjer gzhug bya mdor dbab/ / des rkang pa gnyis po 'di la 'khrugs mi mdzad|

gzhug bya rgyas 'bar ba'i phreng 'khrugs drag po ni/ / sa bon las phyag mtshan/ mngon byang bzhi pa'i skabs su gsung kun gang gi dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed tsam na ā li kā li nyi zla'i bar sa bon phyag mtshan yig 'brus mtshan/ de las 'od 'phros te sems can thams cad kyi don byas nas tshur 'dus| yang na tshogs bsags/ de nas paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma/ der hūm̐ las rdo rje rgya gram lte bar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer/ de las ra gur yang spro/ tu rnam par spro bar gsum pa/ bya/ / ā li las zla chos 'byung gi nang du/ ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi/ dbus gnas*/ / mngon byang dang po dang gnyis par| ā li kā li gong 'og la rim pa bzhin sa bon phreng ba de nas

mtha' skor la/ dgod/ / 'khor gyi lha ma dbyung ba de nas rgyu/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rtsa rgyud ltar chags chen las/ /rig mar bcas pa khu bar gyur/ / pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang du bzhengs don du/ sna tshogs nyid sgra'| glu yis mchod pa las/ /de nas rig mas bskul bar bya/ / rtsa rgyud ltar rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas/ /kye yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas// gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ /bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ / mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig / thig le las aṃ dang hūm̐ las rdo rje che/ brdzus skyes te/ thig le las/ sa bon las bzhengs pa'am/ yang na pad mtha' ltar kyang rung gsung*/ khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni/ /zhabs rnams sa la brdebs pa dang*/ /lha dang lha min sdigs par mdzad/ /gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ/ 'di yi sgo'i dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdang gling bu ma sogs bzhi'i ming gi dang po/ sa bon dbyung bar bya/ / nyi zla'i bar du bdag po dga' ma'i sa bon hūm̐ dang aṃ/ las/ /aṃ hūṃ sngon po 'bar brtsigs pas/ / las rdo rje dang gri gug la so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa la/ hūm̐ las yab/ aṃ las yum/ ma mo'i 'khor lo grong nyams dgar/ /gtso bo 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang*/ 'di ltar bsgom par bya/ /zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /phyag ni bcu drug rnams kyis brgyan/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa dang*/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs pa po/ /1 gar dgu'i ro 2spyir gar gi nyams dgu po bram ze nag po zhabs kyi rnam 'gyur la/

ḍoṃ bhi was lus kyi la3bdag med ma yis mgul nas 'khyud/ /ces pa dang*/ g.yon dmar zhes pa 'am/ gcer bur zhes pa ni sgeg pa'i nyams so||bdud bzhi mnan pa dang*/ stag gi sham thabs ni dpa' ba'i nyams so/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes spyi bor mtshan pa'am/ thod pa lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ phyag na thod pa bcu drug bsnams pa dang*/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa dang*/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal ni mi sdug pa'i nyams so/ /zhal nas hūm̐ spro ba dang*/ ha har bzhad pa ni rgod pa'o/ kha dog nag po 'jigs chen po/ /zhes pa dang*/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhis phyug pa dang*/ lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba bzhin/ /zhes pa ni drag shul gyi nyams so/ /skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa dang*/ nyi mar bzhugs shing rol mor bcas/ /zhes pa ni 'jigs su rung ba'o/ /phyag mtshan bcu drug gis spang bya nad brgyad sel ba dang*/ dbang phyug brgyad ster ba ni snying rje'i nyams so/ /sgeg pa la sogs pa nyams kyi gnyis ka can lta bur 'dug pa/ drag shul gyi zhe sdang can lta bur dag mi 'gal ba ni ngo mtshar ba'i nyams so| |g.yas dkar ba ni zhi ba'i nyams so/ / sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid | | brgya phyed mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal mdzad/ / mi sdug nyi mar bzhugs shing rol mor bcas/ 'jigs su rung*/ kha dog nag po 'jigs pa po'i/ drag shul/ /sna chos rje sa paṇa gsung rab kha skong pod gnyis pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 40PAGE 39
